```plantuml
    BMS --> Staff: Confirmation of bond deletion
end

Staff -> BMS: Close Bond Management Interface
BMS --> Staff: Close confirmation
```
```plantuml
@enduml
```

        deactivate Inventory
    end

    System --> Member: Display related books\nwith shelf numbers
    deactivate System
end

Agg --> Gateway: Aggregated multi-dataset result
deactivate Agg

Gateway --> Client: 200 OK\n(aggregated result payload)
deactivate Gateway

Client -> User: Render experience\n(using combined data from both datasets)

plantuml:
@startuml
title Upload EAD for Import from Frontend

actor Archivist as A
participant "Web Browser\n(Frontend UI)" as FE
participant "Frontend Backend\n(API Gateway / Web App)" as BE
participant "EAD Import Service" as EAD
database "Repository / DB" as DB
collections "File Storage\n(Blob Store)" as FS

== Initiate Upload ==

A -> FE : Select EAD file\nand click "Upload"
FE -> FE : Validate file locally\n(type, size, extension)

alt Client-side validation fails
  FE -> A : Show validation error
  return
end

== Send File to Backend ==

FE -> BE : POST /ead/import\n(multipart/form-data: EAD file, metadata)
activate BE
BE -> BE : Authenticate & Authorize\n(verify Archivist role)

alt Not authorized
  BE -> FE : 403 Forbidden\n(error message)
  deactivate BE
  FE -> A : Display authorization error
  return
end

BE -> BE : Basic request validation\n(filename, size, mimetype)

alt Validation fails
  BE -> FE : 400 Bad Request\n(validation errors)
  deactivate BE
  FE -> A : Display validation errors
  return
end

== Store File and Create Import Record ==

BE -> FS : Store EAD file\n(stream upload)
FS --> BE : File reference / URL

BE -> DB : INSERT ImportJob\n(status = \"PENDING\",\nfileRef, userId, timestamp)
DB --> BE : ImportJob ID

BE -> EAD : StartImport(ImportJob ID,\nfileRef, userId)
activate EAD
EAD -> DB : UPDATE ImportJob\n(status = \"IN_PROGRESS\")
DB --> EAD : OK

BE --> FE : 202 Accepted\n(ImportJob ID, status = PENDING)
deactivate BE

FE -> A : Show \"Import started\"\nwith ImportJob ID

== Asynchronous Import Processing ==

EAD -> FS : Read EAD file\nby fileRef
FS --> EAD : EAD content

EAD -> EAD : Parse & validate EAD\n(schema, structure, required fields)

alt EAD parsing/validation fails
  EAD -> DB : UPDATE ImportJob\nstatus = \"FAILED\",\nerrorDetails
  DB --> EAD : OK
else EAD parsing successful
  EAD -> DB : Persist archival data\n(records, components, metadata)
  DB --> EAD : OK
  EAD -> DB : UPDATE ImportJob\nstatus = \"COMPLETED\"
  DB --> EAD : OK
end

deactivate EAD

== Status Check (Optional) ==

A -> FE : Request import status
FE -> BE : GET /ead/import/{ImportJob ID}
BE -> DB : SELECT ImportJob\nby ID
DB --> BE : ImportJob(status,\nerrorDetails?)
BE --> FE : ImportJob status\n(and details)
FE -> A : Display current status\n(COMPLETED / FAILED / IN_PROGRESS)

@enduml

            NS --> RS : NotificationSent

            RS --> UI : CancelReservationSuccess(reservationId)
            UI --> Member : Show cancellation confirmation
        end
    end
end

plantuml:
@startuml
title Change Orders of a Table

actor Employee as E
participant "POS System" as POS
database "Order Service" as OS
database "Table Service" as TS
database "Menu Service" as MS
database "Payment Service" as PS

E -> POS: Select table to modify
POS -> TS: GET tableStatus(tableId)
TS --> POS: tableStatus (OPEN / IN_USE)

alt Table is available for modification
    POS -> OS: GET currentOrders(tableId)
    OS --> POS: currentOrders

    E -> POS: Modify orders\n(add / remove / change quantity)
    loop For each modification
        alt Add item
            POS -> MS: GET menuItem(itemId)
            MS --> POS: menuItemDetails
            POS -> OS: POST addOrderItem(tableId, item)
            OS --> POS: orderItemAdded
        else Remove item
            POS -> OS: DELETE orderItem(orderItemId)
            OS --> POS: orderItemRemoved
        else Change quantity
            POS -> OS: PATCH orderItem(orderItemId, newQty)
            OS --> POS: orderItemUpdated
        end
    end

    POS -> OS: GET updatedOrders(tableId)
    OS --> POS: updatedOrders

    POS -> PS: Recalculate bill(tableId, updatedOrders)
    PS --> POS: updatedBill

    POS -> E: Show updated orders and bill
    E -> POS: Confirm changes
    POS -> OS: PUT finalizeChanges(tableId, updatedOrders)
    OS --> POS: changesFinalized
    POS -> E: Display success message
else Table cannot be modified
    POS -> E: Show error: "Table cannot be modified now"
end

@enduml

end

group Combine & Transform Results

end

plantuml:
@startuml
title Load Data Package from R

actor Consumer
participant "R Session" as R
participant "Data Package Loader\n(Function/Package)" as Loader
participant "Data Package Repository\n(CRAN/Remote)" as Repo
database "Local Library\n(File System)" as LocalFS

== Start Loading Data Package ==

Consumer -> R : call loadDataPackage(packageName)
activate R

R -> Loader : loadDataPackage(packageName)
activate Loader

Loader -> LocalFS : checkIfInstalled(packageName)
activate LocalFS
LocalFS --> Loader : installed? (true/false)
deactivate LocalFS

alt Package already installed
    Loader -> LocalFS : loadFromLocal(packageName)
    activate LocalFS
    LocalFS --> Loader : dataObjects
    deactivate LocalFS

    Loader --> R : dataObjects
    deactivate Loader

    R --> Consumer : data ready in workspace
    deactivate R

else Package not installed
    Loader -> Repo : fetchPackage(packageName)
    activate Repo
    Repo --> Loader : packageArchive / error
    deactivate Repo

    alt Fetch successful
        Loader -> LocalFS : installPackage(packageArchive)
        activate LocalFS
        LocalFS --> Loader : installResult (success)
        deactivate LocalFS

        Loader -> LocalFS : loadFromLocal(packageName)
        activate LocalFS
        LocalFS --> Loader : dataObjects
        deactivate LocalFS

        Loader --> R : dataObjects
        deactivate Loader

        R --> Consumer : data ready in workspace
        deactivate R

    else Fetch failed
        Loader --> R : error("Unable to load data package")
        deactivate Loader

        R --> Consumer : display error message
        deactivate R
    end
end

@enduml

actor "Staff Member" as Staff

database "Bond Database" as BondDB
participant "Project Service" as ProjectService
participant "Notification Service" as NotificationService
participant "Reporting Service" as ReportingService
participant "Audit Service" as AuditService

== Access Bond Management ==

Staff -> UI: Open Bond Management Screen
UI -> BondService: GET /bonds?projectId={id}
BondService -> ProjectService: Validate project(id)
ProjectService --> BondService: Project details (status, validity)
BondService -> BondDB: SELECT bonds WHERE projectId = {id}
BondDB --> BondService: Bond list
BondService -> UI: Bond list + project info
UI --> Staff: Display bonds and actions

== Create New Bond ==

Staff -> UI: Create new bond (enter details)
UI -> BondService: POST /bonds (bond data)
BondService -> ProjectService: Validate project and bond rules
ProjectService --> BondService: OK / validation result
alt Validation OK
  BondService -> BondDB: INSERT new bond
  BondDB --> BondService: New bond ID
  BondService -> AuditService: Record "BOND_CREATED" event
  AuditService --> BondService: Ack
  BondService -> NotificationService: Notify stakeholders (bond created)
  NotificationService --> BondService: Ack
  BondService -> UI: Bond created (ID, status=Draft)
  UI --> Staff: Show confirmation and updated list
else Validation Failed
  BondService -> UI: Error (validation details)
  UI --> Staff: Display validation errors
end

== Update Bond Details ==

Staff -> UI: Edit bond details
UI -> BondService: PUT /bonds/{bondId} (updated data)
BondService -> BondDB: SELECT bond WHERE id={bondId}
BondDB --> BondService: Bond details
BondService -> ProjectService: Validate update against project
ProjectService --> BondService: OK / validation result
alt Validation OK
  BondService -> BondDB: UPDATE bond
  BondDB --> BondService: Ack
  BondService -> AuditService: Record "BOND_UPDATED" event
  AuditService --> BondService: Ack
  BondService -> UI: Updated bond details
  UI --> Staff: Show updated bond
else Validation Failed
  BondService -> UI: Error (validation details)
  UI --> Staff: Display validation errors
end

== Change Bond Status (e.g., Activate / Release) ==

Staff -> UI: Change bond status (e.g., Activate)
UI -> BondService: PATCH /bonds/{bondId}/status (newStatus)
BondService -> BondDB: SELECT bond WHERE id={bondId}
BondDB --> BondService: Bond details
BondService -> ProjectService: Check project state and rules
ProjectService --> BondService: OK / not allowed
alt Status Change Allowed
  BondService -> BondDB: UPDATE bond.status
  BondDB --> BondService: Ack
  BondService -> AuditService: Record "BOND_STATUS_CHANGED" event
  AuditService --> BondService: Ack
  BondService -> NotificationService: Notify stakeholders (status change)
  NotificationService --> BondService: Ack
  BondService -> UI: Updated bond status
  UI --> Staff: Show updated bond status
else Status Change Not Allowed
  BondService -> UI: Error (status change not permitted)
  UI --> Staff: Display error
end

== Track Bond Over Project Lifecycle ==

Staff -> UI: View bond lifecycle history
UI -> BondService: GET /bonds/{bondId}/history
BondService -> BondDB: SELECT bond WHERE id={bondId}
BondDB --> BondService: Bond details
BondService -> AuditService: GET events for bondId
AuditService --> BondService: Event history
BondService -> UI: Bond details + lifecycle history
UI --> Staff: Display lifecycle timeline

BondService -> BondDB: SELECT bonds WHERE projectId={id}
BondDB --> BondService: Bond list
BondService -> ReportingService: Generate bond report (bonds, project)

BondService -> UI: Report link / data
UI --> Staff: Display/download report

actor "Worker" as Worker

collections "Notification Service" as Notif

== Manager Login ==

Manager -> UI: Open app / login page

UI -> Auth: Validate credentials
Auth --> UI: Auth token / session
UI --> Manager: Login success\n(show dashboard)

== Manager Creates Task ==

Manager -> UI: Create new task\n(details, priority, due time)
UI -> TaskSvc: POST /tasks\n(task details, manager ID)
TaskSvc -> TaskDB: INSERT new task\n(status = 'Pending')
TaskDB --> TaskSvc: Task created\n(task ID)
TaskSvc -> Notif: Notify available workers\n(new task created)

TaskSvc -> TaskDB: SELECT tasks\nby worker ID
TaskDB --> TaskSvc: Assigned tasks
TaskSvc --> UI: Return worker tasks
UI --> Worker: Display assigned tasks

Worker -> UI: Update task status\n(e.g. In Progress, Completed)
UI -> TaskSvc: PUT /tasks/{id}/status\n(new status)
TaskSvc -> TaskDB: UPDATE task status
TaskDB --> TaskSvc: Update success
TaskSvc -> Notif: Notify manager\n(task status changed)
Notif --> Manager: Status update notification
TaskSvc --> UI: Status update confirmation
UI --> Worker: Show updated task status

== Manager Monitors Updated Status ==

Manager -> UI: Refresh task board
UI -> TaskSvc: GET /tasks?managerId=...
TaskSvc -> TaskDB: SELECT tasks\nwith latest statuses
TaskDB --> TaskSvc: Updated task list
TaskSvc --> UI: Return updated tasks
UI --> Manager: Display updated statuses\n(for all tasks)

@enduml

participant "Dataset Orchestrator" as Orchestrator
database "Dataset A Service" as DatasetA
database "Dataset B Service" as DatasetB
database "Dataset C Service" as DatasetC

User -> Client: Configure request\n(multiple datasets, filters)
Client -> APIGW: POST /multi-dataset-query\n(request payload)
APIGW -> Orchestrator: Validate & forward request

Orchestrator -> Orchestrator: Parse requested datasets\n& query parameters

group Validate request
    Orchestrator -> Orchestrator: Check dataset availability\nand access rights
    Orchestrator -> APIGW: Error (invalid/unauthorized)? 
    APIGW -> Client: 4xx error\n(if validation fails)
    Client -> User: Show error\n(if any)
    return
end

par Query Dataset A
    Orchestrator -> DatasetA: Query(data filters, fields)
    DatasetA --> Orchestrator: Dataset A results
end

par Query Dataset B
    Orchestrator -> DatasetB: Query(data filters, fields)
    DatasetB --> Orchestrator: Dataset B results
end

par Query Dataset C
    Orchestrator -> DatasetC: Query(data filters, fields)
    DatasetC --> Orchestrator: Dataset C results
end

Orchestrator -> Orchestrator: Normalize & merge\nresults from all datasets
Orchestrator -> Orchestrator: Apply cross-dataset\ntransformations & joins

alt Any dataset query fails
    Orchestrator -> APIGW: Partial/failed result\nwith error details
    APIGW -> Client: 207 Multi-Status\nor 5xx with error info
    Client -> User: Display partial/failed\nresults and errors
else All dataset queries succeed
    Orchestrator --> APIGW: Aggregated multi-dataset result
    APIGW --> Client: 200 OK\n(merged dataset response)
    Client --> User: Render experience\nbased on multiple datasets
```plantuml
end
```

user_story: As a Plan Review Staff member, I want to Review Plans, so that I can review them for compliance and either approve, or fail or deny the plans and record any conditions, clearances, or corrections needed from the Applicant.
plantuml:
```plantuml
@startuml
actor "Plan Review Staff" as PRS
participant "Plan Submission System" as PSS
participant "Applicant" as Applicant

activate PRS
PRS -> PSS : Select Plans for Review
activate PSS
PSS --> PRS : Retrieve Plan Details
deactivate PSS

PRS -> PSS : Review Plan(s)
activate PSS
PSS -> PSS : Validate Plan Compliance
alt Plan Compliant
    PSS --> PRS : Plan Approved
    PRS --> Applicant : Notify Approval
    deactivate PSS
else Plan Requires Correction/Condition
    PSS -> PSS : Identify Corrections/Conditions
    PSS --> PRS : List Corrections/Conditions
    PRS -> Applicant : Request Corrections/Conditions
    activate Applicant
    Applicant -> PSS : Submit Revised Plans with Corrections/Conditions
    deactivate Applicant
    PSS -> PSS : Validate Revised Plan Compliance
    alt Revised Plan Compliant 
        PSS --> PRS : Revised Plan Approved
        PRS --> Applicant : Notify Approval
    else Revised Plan Still Requires Correction/Condition
        PSS --> PRS : List Remaining Corrections/Conditions
        PRS -> Applicant : Request Further Corrections/Conditions
        activate Applicant
        Applicant -> PSS : Submit Revised Plans with Corrections/Conditions
        deactivate Applicant
        loop Until Revised Plan Compliant or Max Attempts Reached
            PSS -> PSS : Validate Revised Plan Compliance
            alt Revised Plan Compliant 
                PSS --> PRS : Revised Plan Approved
                PRS --> Applicant : Notify Approval
```

    endif
endif
```plantuml
@enduml
```

1. The `User` requests orders by date from the `Manager`.

3. The `OrderDB` returns the orders by date to the `Manager`.

user_story: As a user, I want to take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image.
plantuml:
Here's the PlantUML code for the sequence diagram representing the interactions described in the user story:

```plantuml
@startuml
actor User
participant "Mobile App" as App
participant "Image Processing Service" as ImgProc
participant "Video Recommendation Service" as VidRec
database "User Data" as UserData

User -> App: Take a picture or upload an image
App -> ImgProc: Send image for processing
ImgProc -> VidRec: Analyze image and generate video recommendations
VidRec -> ImgProc: Return video recommendations
ImgProc -> App: Send video recommendations to the user
App -> User: Display recommended videos
@enduml
```

This sequence diagram includes the following main actors and system components:

- User: The end-user who interacts with the mobile app.
- Mobile App (App): The mobile application through which the user interacts with the system.
- Image Processing Service (ImgProc): A service that processes the uploaded or captured image.
- Video Recommendation Service (VidRec): A service that analyzes the image and generates video recommendations.
- User Data (UserData): A database that stores user-related information.

The sequence of messages is as follows:

1. The user takes a picture or uploads an image through the mobile app.
2. The mobile app sends the image to the Image Processing Service for analysis.
3. The Image Processing Service sends the image to the Video Recommendation Service for generating video recommendations based on the image content.
4. The Video Recommendation Service analyzes the image and sends the generated video recommendations back to the Image Processing Service.
5. The Image Processing Service sends the video recommendations to the mobile app.
6. The mobile app displays the recommended videos to the user.

The diagram follows valid PlantUML syntax and represents the interactions between the main actors and system components in the context of the user story.

user_story: As a chef, I want to create dishes so that I can follow customer comments.
plantuml:
Here's the PlantUML code for the sequence diagram based on the given user story:

```plantuml
@startuml
actor Chef
participant Customer

component System {
  participant ChefApp
  participant CommentService
  participant DishRepository
}

note left of Chef: "As a chef, I want to create dishes so that I can follow customer comments."
note right of Customer: "I can submit comments on dishes."

Chef -> Customer: Submit comment
Customer -> CommentService: Create comment
CommentService -> DishRepository: Store comment
DishRepository -> DishRepository: Update dish with new comment
DishRepository -> DishRepository: Retrieve dish
DishRepository -> ChefApp: Pass updated dish
ChefApp -> Chef: Notify about updated dish
Chef -> Customer: Acknowledge comment
Customer -> Customer: View updated dish
@enduml
```

This PlantUML code defines the following:

Actors:
- Chef: The chef who wants to create dishes and follow customer comments.
- Customer: The customer who submits comments on dishes.

System Components:
- ChefApp: The application component where the chef interacts with the system.
- CommentService: The service component responsible for handling comments.
- DishRepository: The repository component where dish information is stored and retrieved.

Sequence of Interactions:
1. The chef submits a comment for a dish through the ChefApp.
2. The CommentService receives the comment and stores it in the DishRepository.
3. The DishRepository updates the dish with the new comment and retrieves the updated dish information.
4. The DishRepository passes the updated dish information to the ChefApp.
5. The ChefApp notifies the chef about the updated dish.
6. The chef acknowledges the comment from the customer.
7. The customer views the updated dish.

The PlantUML code represents the actors, system components, and the sequence of interactions between them based on the given user story.

user_story: As a user, I want to have nice error pages when something goes wrong, so that I can trust the system and its developers.
plantuml:
Here's the PlantUML sequence diagram for the given user story:

```plantuml
@startuml
actor User
participant "Web Server" as WS
participant "Error Handler" as EH
participant "Error Page Generator" as EP
participant "Template Engine" as TE
participant "Error Page" as EPAGE

User -> WS: Request
WS -> EH: Process Request
alt Request is valid
    EH -> EP: Generate Error Page
    EP -> TE: Render Error Page
    TE -> EPAGE: Return Error Page
else Request is invalid
    EH -> WS: Return Error Page
    WS -> User: Error Page
end
@enduml
```

This sequence diagram represents the following interactions:

1. The User makes a request to the Web Server.
2. The Web Server processes the request.
3. If the request is valid, the Error Handler interacts with the Error Page Generator to generate a normal page.
4. The Error Page Generator interacts with the Template Engine to render the normal page.
5. The Template Engine returns the rendered normal page to the Error Page Generator.
6. The Error Page Generator returns the normal page to the Error Handler.
7. The Error Handler returns the normal page to the Web Server.
8. The Web Server returns the normal page to the User.

If the request is invalid:

1. The Web Server processes the request.
2. The Error Handler interacts with the Error Page Generator to generate an error page.
3. The Error Page Generator interacts with the Template Engine to render the error page.
4. The Template Engine returns the rendered error page to the Error Page Generator.
5. The Error Page Generator returns the error page to the Error Handler.
6. The Error Handler returns the error page to the Web Server.
7. The Web Server returns the error page to the User.

This sequence diagram illustrates the interactions between the User, Web Server, Error Handler, Error Page Generator, Template Engine, and Error Page components to provide nice error pages when something goes wrong in the system.

user_story: As a developer, I want to upgrade to Fedora 4 and migrate our applications and data.
plantuml:
```plantuml
@startuml
' Actors and system components
actor "Upgrade Service" as Upgrade
participant "Fedora 4 System" as Fedora
participant "Application Server" as AppServer
participant "Data Store" as DataStore
participant "Migration Engine" as MigrationEngine

== Initiate Upgrade ==
Upgrade -> Fedora : receiveUpgradeRequest()
Fedora -> Upgrade : requestVersionInfo()
Fedora -> MigrationEngine : requestVersionInfo()
MigrationEngine --> Fedora : versionInfo()
note right of Fedora : Checks current version

== Verify Compatibility ==
Fedora -> MigrationEngine : verifyVersion()
alt compatible
    MigrationEngine -> Upgrade : confirmVersion()
    Upgrade -> Application : initiateAppUpgrade()
    Upgrade -> Developer : notifyUpgradeStart()
else incompatible
    Upgrade -> Developer : notifyUpgradeNotPossible()
    stop
end

== Migrate Applications ==
Upgrade -> MigrationEngine : startAppMigration()
MigrationEngine -> AppServer : prepareUpgrade()
MigrationEngine -> DataStore : exportAppData()
DataStore --> MigrationEngine : dataExported()
MigrationEngine -> AppServer : sendAppData()
DataStore -> Migration Engine : confirmDataRestored()
MigrationEngine -> AppServer : completeAppDeployment()
AppServer --> MigrationEngine : appDeployed()

== Migrate Data ==
MigrationEngine -> DataStore : exportData()
DataStore --> MigrationEngine : dataExported()
DataStore -> MigrationEngine : importData()
MigrationEngine -> DataStore : confirmDataRestored()
DataStore --> MigrationEngine : dataRestored()

== Verify Deployment ==
Fedora -> MigrationEngine : verifyApplications()
MigrationEngine --> Fedora : applicationsVerified()
MigrationEngine -> Fedora : verifyDataMigration()
MigrationEngine --> Fedora : dataMigrationVerified()

== Complete Upgrade ==
Fedora -> Developer : sendUpgradeSuccess()
@enduml
```

```plantuml
participant "Resource Tracker" as Tracker

    Tracker -> DB : SELECT * FROM resources

    Tracker -> Manager : confirmUpdate()
else
    Tracker -> Manager : resource not found
end

@enduml
```

```plantuml
loop for each volunteer in volunteerList
    Scheduler -> Volunteer : getStats()

    Scheduler -> Analyzer : evaluateVolunteer(volunteer)

    Analyzer --> AdminPortal : recommendEducate(volunteer)
else
    Analyzer -> Analyzer : noAction()
end

'3. Admin decides based on recommendation
```

user_story: As an asset manager, I want to know what the intellectual value of the asset is to the institution at the time of deposit, so that I obtain guidance in the evaluation of it for current value for the institution.
plantuml:
```plantuml
@startuml
'--- Actors -------------------------------------------------
actor "Asset Manager" as AM
actor "Institution\n(Asset Manager)" as AM_Actor

'--- System Actors -------------------------------------------------
actor "Guidance Service" as Guidance
actor "Valuation Engine" as ValEngine
actor "Intellectual Value Service" as IntVal

'--- System Components -------------------------------------------------
participant "Deposit UI\n(Front‑End)" as UI
participant "Deposit Controller" as DepCtrl
participant "Intellectual Value Processor" as IVP
participant "Valuation Service" as ValSvc
participant "Guidance Engine" as GuideEngine
database "Institution Repository" as InstRepo

'--- Interaction -------------------------------------------------
UI -> DepCtrl : startDeposit()
DepCtrl -> UI : acknowledge()
activate DepCtrl

DepCtrl -> UI : requestAssetMetadata()
UI -> UI : displayMetadata()
UI -> UI : prompt for valuation request (optional)

DepCtrl -> ValEngine : calculateIntellectualValue()
activate ValEngine
ValEngine -> IVP : computeValue(metadata)
activate IVP
IVP -> IntVal : evaluateIntellectualValue()
IntVal --> IVP : valueResult()
IVP --> ValEngine : valueResult()
ValEngine --> DepCtrl : valuationResult()
ValEngine --> ValEngine : applyPolicies()
ValEngine --> ValEngine : produce valuationOutcome()
ValEngine --> DepCtrl : valuationOutcome()
ValEngine --> Guidance : requestGuidance(valuationOutcome)
ValEngine --> ValEngine : (internal policy checks)

ValEngine --> ValEngine : return valuationResult()
ValEngine --> DepCtrl : valuationResult()
DepCtrl --> DepCtrl : assembleGuidance()
DepCtrl --> Guidance : provideGuidance()
DepCtrl --> AM_Actor : showValuationResult()
@enduml
```

**Explanation of the sequence**

1. The **Asset Manager** (actor) initiates the deposit via the UI.  
2. The UI forwards the request to the Deposit Controller (`DepCtrl`).  
3. The controller asks the **Intellectual Value Service** (via the **Valuation Engine**) to compute the intellectual value.  
4. The **Valuation Engine** invokes the **Intellectual Value Service** (`IntVal`) which performs the actual intellectual‑value calculation.  
5. The calculated value is returned up the stack to the controller.  
6. The controller calls the **Guidance Engine** to obtain guidance based on the valuation outcome.  
7. The guidance is sent back to the UI and displayed to the Asset Manager.  

All actors, system components, and the sequence of messages are represented in the PlantUML code above.

user_story: As a moderator, I want to export a transcript of a game as a CSV file, so that I can further process the stories and estimates.
plantuml:
```plantuml
@startuml
' Actors
actor Moderator

' System components (high‑level)
boundary "Auth Service" as Auth
boundary "Web UI" as UI
boundary "Export Controller\n(Backend)" as ExportCtrl
boundary "CSV Generator" as CSVGen
boundary "File Storage" as FileStore

' ==============================
' Identify the actors / components
' ==============================
' - Moderator (actor) interacts with the UI to log in and initiate the export.
' - Auth Service validates the moderator’s credentials and issues an auth token.
' - Export Controller (backend) orchestrates the export workflow.
' - CSV Generator converts game data to CSV format.
' - File Storage persists the generated CSV file and provides a download URL.

' ==============================
' Sequence of interactions
' ==============================
' 1. UI asks Auth Service for login credentials
activate Auth
UI -> Auth : POST /login\n(username, pwd)
Auth --> UI : 200 OK\n(token)
deactivate Auth

' 2. UI requests the game list (optional, for context)
activate GameService
UI -> GameService : GET /games
GameService --> UI : 200 OK\n(games list)
deactivate GameService

' 3. UI initiates the transcript export
activate ExportCtrl
UI -> ExportCtrl : POST /export\n{gameId, authToken}
ExportCtrl -> Auth : validateToken(authToken)
Auth --> ExportCtrl : 200 OK\n(token valid)
deactivate Auth

' 3a. Export Controller asks Game Service for raw game data
activate GameService
GameService -> GameService : fetchGameData(gameId)
GameService --> ExportCtrl : 200 OK\n{moves, timestamps, …}
deactivate GameService

' 3b. Export Controller converts data to CSV
activate CSVGen
ExportCtrl -> CSVGen : generateCSV(data)
CSVGen --> ExportCtrl : 200 OK\n{csvContent}
deactivate CSVGen

' 3c. Export Controller stores the CSV file
ExportCtrl -> CSVGen : POST /store\n{filename, content}
CSVGen --> ExportCtrl : 201 Created\n{fileId}
ExportCtrl -> CSVGen : GET /download/{fileId}
CSVGen --> ExportCtrl : 200 OK\n{downloadUrl}
deactivate ExportCtrl

' 4. UI receives the download URL and triggers download
activate FileStore
UI -> FileStore : GET /files/{fileId}
FileStore --> UI : 200 OK\n{csvFile}
deactivate FileStore

' 5. UI presents the download link to the Moderator
note right of UI
    The UI shows a "Download CSV" button.
    On click it uses the\n{downloadUrl} to download the file.
end note

@enduml
```

user_story: As a DigitalRecords Archivist, I want to expose the descriptive record for each ETD item for re-use external to Fedora.
plantuml:
**Actors**
- DigitalRecordsArchivist
- ExternalConsumer

**System Components**
- Archivist UI (Web UI)
- ETD Repository Service
- DescriptiveMetadata Service
- Record Exposure Service
- External API Gateway (for OAI‑PMH)

**Sequence of Interactions**

1. **Archivist → UI**: Request list of ETD items.  
2. **UI → ETD Repository Service**: `getETDList()` → returns list of ETD IDs.  
3. **UI → UI**: Populate list for selection.  
4. **Archivist → UI**: Click **Expose Record** for selected ETD.  
5. **UI → DescriptiveMetadata Service**: `fetchMetadata(ETD_ID)` → retrieves descriptive metadata.  
6. **DescriptiveMetadata Service → Fedora Repository**: `retrieveMetadata(ETD_ID)` → returns metadata.  
7. **UI → Record Exposure Service**: `createExposedRecord(metadata)` → generates external‑accessible record.  
8. **Record Exposure Service → UI**: Returns external record URL.  
9. **UI → Archivist**: Show success message with external URL.  
10. **ExternalConsumer → External API**: Request descriptive record for ETD ID.  
11. **External API → UI**: Serve metadata (e.g., JSON/REST or OAI‑PMH).

```plantuml
@startuml
actor DigitalRecordsArchivist as Archivist
actor ExternalConsumer as ExternalConsumer

participant "Archivist UI" as UI
participant "ETD Repository Service" as Repo
participant "Descriptive Metadata Service" as Metadata
participant "Record Exposure Service" as Exposure
participant "External API\n(OAI‑PMH)" as API

Archivist -> UI : Request ETD list
UI -> Repo : getETDList()
Repo --> UI : ETD_ID list
UI -> UI : Populate list

== Select item & expose ==

UI -> UI : Show loading
UI -> UI : Call Record Exposure Service
UI -> "Descriptive Metadata Service" as DMS
UI -> DMS : fetchMetadata(ETD_ID)
DMS -> "Fedora Repository" as Fedora : retrieveMetadata(ETD_ID)
Fedora --> DMS : metadata
DMS --> UI : Metadata
UI -> "Record Exposure Service" : createExposedRecord(metadata)
UI -> Exposure : return external URL
Exposure --> UI : exposure URL
UI -> UI : Show success + URL
UI -> UI : Trigger external registration
UI -> API : registerExposedRecord(recordURL)
API --> UI : acknowledgement
@enduml
```

user_story: As a customer, I want to be able to pay the bill partially
plantuml:
```plantuml
@startuml
```
actor Customer
```plantuml
participant "Payment System" as PS
participant "Bill Management" as BM
participant "Payment Gateway" as PG
database "Database" as DB

Customer -> PS: Request to pay bill partially
activate PS

PS -> BM: Get bill details
activate BM

BM -> DB: Retrieve bill information
activate DB
DB --> BM: Return bill details
deactivate DB
```

```plantuml
BM --> PS: Return bill details (total amount, outstanding)
deactivate BM

PS -> Customer: Display bill and request partial payment amount
deactivate PS

Customer -> PS: Enter partial payment amount
activate PS

PS -> PS: Validate payment amount
alt Invalid amount (exceeds outstanding or <= 0)
    PS --> Customer: Display error message
else Valid amount
    PS -> PG: Process partial payment
    activate PG
    
    PG -> PG: Process transaction
    
    alt Payment successful
        PG --> PS: Payment confirmation
        deactivate PG
        
        PS -> BM: Update bill with partial payment
        activate BM
        
        BM -> DB: Update outstanding amount
        activate DB
        DB --> BM: Confirmation
        deactivate DB
        
        BM --> PS: Update successful
        deactivate BM
        
        PS --> Customer: Display payment confirmation and remaining balance
    else Payment failed
        PG --> PS: Payment failed
        PS --> Customer: Display payment failure message
    end
end

deactivate PS

@enduml
```

```plantuml
@startuml
```
```plantuml
title NeuroHub to Web Calendar Sync

participant User as U
participant NeuroHub as NH
participant "Calendar Sync Service" as CSS
participant "Google Calendar API" as GCA
participant "Google Calendar" as GC

U -> NH: Initiates "Sync Calendar" action
activate NH

NH -> CSS: Request to sync events for UserX
activate CSS

CSS -> NH: Fetch events created/updated since last sync
NH --> CSS: Returns list of events (Event A, Event B, ...)

alt User Authorization Required
    CSS -> GCA: Request OAuth2 Authorization URL
    GCA --> CSS: Returns Authorization URL
    CSS -> U: Redirect/Prompt for Google Calendar authorization
    U -> GCA: Grants Authorization (via browser)
    GCA --> U: Redirects back to CSS with Authorization Code
    CSS -> GCA: Exchange Authorization Code for Access/Refresh Tokens
    GCA --> CSS: Returns Access and Refresh Tokens
else User Already Authorized
    CSS -> GCA: Use existing Access/Refresh Tokens
end

loop For each event in the list
    CSS -> GCA: Check if event exists in Google Calendar (by ID)
    alt Event exists and needs update
        GCA --> CSS: Event ID found, needs update
        CSS -> GCA: Update Event (Event ID, new details)
        GCA --> CSS: Update Acknowledged
    else Event exists and is up-to-date

    else Event does not exist
        GCA --> CSS: Event ID not found
        CSS -> GCA: Create New Event (Event details)
        GCA --> CSS: New Event ID (Google Event ID)
    end
    GC <- GCA: Stores/Updates event details
end

CSS --> NH: Sync complete status (success/failure)
deactivate CSS

deactivate NH
```

```plantuml
@startuml
```
```plantuml
title Partial Bill Payment

actor Customer
boundary Payment_UI as "Payment UI"
participant Payment_Service as "Payment Service"
participant Billing_Service as "Billing Service"
participant Payment_Gateway as "Payment Gateway"
participant Bank as "Customer's Bank"

Customer -> "Payment UI": View Bill Details
"Payment UI" --> Customer: Display Bill (Total Amount: $X)

Customer -> "Payment UI": Select "Pay Partially"\nEnter Partial Amount ($Y)

activate "Payment UI"
"Payment UI" -> Payment_Service: InitiatePartialPayment(billId, amount=$Y)
activate Payment_Service

Payment_Service -> Payment_Service: Validate partial amount (e.g., > 0, < total)

Payment_Service -> Payment_Gateway: ProcessPayment(amount=$Y, customerDetails)
activate Payment_Gateway

Payment_Gateway -> Bank: AuthorizePayment(amount=$Y)
activate Bank
Bank --> Payment_Gateway: AuthorizationResponse(status)
deactivate Bank

alt Payment Authorized
    Payment_Gateway --> Payment_Service: PaymentSuccessful(transactionId)
    deactivate Payment_Gateway

    Payment_Service -> Billing_Service: UpdateBillPartialPayment(billId, paidAmount=$Y)
    activate Billing_Service
    Billing_Service -> Billing_Service: Calculate new remaining balance
    Billing_Service --> Payment_Service: BillUpdatedConfirmation(newBalance)
    deactivate Billing_Service

    Payment_Service --> "Payment UI": PartialPaymentSuccess(transactionId, newBalance)
    deactivate Payment_Service

    "Payment UI" --> Customer: "Partial Payment Successful!\nRemaining Balance: $Z"
else Payment Failed
    Payment_Gateway --> Payment_Service: PaymentFailed(reason)
    deactivate Payment_Gateway

    Payment_Service --> "Payment UI": PartialPaymentFailed(reason)
    deactivate Payment_Service

    "Payment UI" --> Customer: "Partial Payment Failed: [reason]"
end

deactivate "Payment UI"

@enduml
```

```plantuml
activate Frontend
```

```plantuml
title Data Planning and Storage Feasibility

actor PI as "Principal Investigator"
participant DataPlanningSystem as "Data Planning System"
participant StorageCapability as "Storage Capability"

note right of PI: This includes data volume, format, retention period, security needs, etc.

activate StorageCapability
note right of StorageCapability: Checks available capacity, policies, compatibility, cost, and technical constraints.

deactivate StorageCapability

    PI -> DataPlanningSystem: Revise data requirements or explore alternatives
    DataPlanningSystem -> StorageCapability: Request re-assessment (revised requirements)
    StorageCapability --> DataPlanningSystem: Return new assessment
    DataPlanningSystem --> PI: Display updated feasibility report
else If storage is feasible as-is
    PI -> DataPlanningSystem: Confirm data plan
    note right of DataPlanningSystem: The data plan is finalized and recorded for implementation.
end

@enduml
```

```plantuml
participant "Notification Service" as Notifier
```
```plantuml
participant "Email System" as Email

' Sequence of Interactions

' 1. A DAMS User (could be another manager, or an administrator) modifies data in the DAMS.
DAMSUser -> DAMS: Modifies permitted/restricted act or its active dates

' 2. The DAMS processes the modification.
activate DAMS
DAMS -> DAMS: Validates and applies changes

' 3. Upon successful modification, the DAMS records an event in its event stream/audit log.
DAMS -> EventStream: Emits "Act/Dates Modified" event (e.g., type, details, who, when)
deactivate DAMS

' 4. The Notification Service, which subscribes to or polls the DAMS Event Stream, detects the relevant event.
EventStream --> Notifier: Notifies of "Act/Dates Modified" event asynchronously

' 5. The Notification Service processes the event.
activate Notifier
Notifier -> Notifier: Retrieves details for notification\n(e.g., affected act, old/new dates, modifier)

' 6. The Notification Service sends the composed message to the DAMS Manager via the Email System.
Notifier -> Email: Sends email notification to DAMS Manager
deactivate Notifier

' 7. The Email System delivers the notification.

' 8. The DAMS Manager receives and reads the notification.
```

```plantuml
@startuml
```
actor Admin
participant "Admin Panel" as AdminPanel
participant "User Management System" as UMS
database "Database" as DB

Admin -> AdminPanel: Access Admin Dashboard
activate AdminPanel
AdminPanel --> Admin: Display Dashboard

activate UMS
UMS -> DB: queryActivities()
activate DB

deactivate DB

deactivate UMS
AdminPanel --> Admin: Display User Activities List

loop For each selected activity or user to manage
    Admin -> AdminPanel: Select Activity/User (e.g., User A's login)
    AdminPanel --> Admin: Display Management Options (View, Edit, Suspend, Delete)

    alt Admin chooses to View Details
        Admin -> AdminPanel: View Details
        AdminPanel -> UMS: getActivityDetails(Activity ID)

        UMS -> DB: queryActivity(Activity ID)
        activate DB
        DB --> UMS: activityDetails
        deactivate DB

        UMS -> DB: updateUser(User A, new_data)
        activate DB
        DB --> UMS: updateStatus
        deactivate DB
        UMS --> AdminPanel: userUpdatedConfirmation
        deactivate UMS
        AdminPanel --> Admin: Confirmation: User A Updated
    else Admin chooses to Suspend User

        activate UMS

        activate DB

        deactivate DB
        UMS --> AdminPanel: userSuspendedConfirmation
        deactivate UMS
        AdminPanel --> Admin: Confirmation: User A Suspended
    end
end
deactivate AdminPanel

plantuml:

```plantuml
@startuml
title Fedora 4 Upgrade and Application Migration Sequence

actor Developer as Dev
participant "Old System (Fedora 3)" as OldSys
participant "New System (Fedora 4)" as NewSys
database "Data Store" as DB
participant "App Repository" as Repo

skinparam sequenceMessageAlign center

group Preparation
    Dev -> OldSys: Initiate backup
    OldSys -> DB: Export data (e.g., database dump)
    DB --> OldSys: Backup file created
    OldSys -> Repo: Commit/Push final configurations
    Repo --> OldSys: Acknowledge commit
    OldSys --> Dev: Backups complete
end

group System Provisioning
    Dev -> NewSys: Install Fedora 4 OS
    NewSys --> Dev: Installation successful
    Dev -> NewSys: Install application dependencies (runtimes, libraries)
    NewSys --> Dev: Dependencies installed
end

group Application & Data Migration
    Dev -> Repo: Trigger deployment to new system
    Repo -> NewSys: Clone/Pull application code
    NewSys -> NewSys: Build and configure application
    note right: Application is set up but not running with live data yet.

    Dev -> DB: Initiate data restore
    DB -> NewSys: Restore data from backup file
    NewSys --> Dev: Data migration complete
end

group Validation
    Dev -> NewSys: Start application services
    NewSys --> Dev: Services are running
    Dev -> NewSys: Run smoke tests and validation checks
    alt Tests Pass
        NewSys --> Dev: All checks successful
    else Tests Fail
        NewSys --> Dev: Report errors
        Dev -> NewSys: Debug and apply fixes
        note right: This loop continues until all tests pass.
    end
end

group Go-Live
    Dev -> Dev: Update DNS / Load Balancer to point to NewSys IP
    note right: Traffic is now routed to the new system.
    Dev -> OldSys: Decommission and shut down
end
```

```plantuml
skinparam sequence {
    ParticipantBackgroundColor #ADD8E6
    ActorBackgroundColor #90EE90
}

group Initial Page Load (Optimized for speed)
    User -> UI: Requests a page with many flexfields
    activate UI
    UI -> Backend: GET /api/resource/{id}
    activate Backend
    note right of UI: Requests primary resource data only.

    Backend -> DB: Fetch primary resource data (without flexfields)
    activate DB
    DB --> Backend: Return primary resource data
    deactivate DB

    Backend --> UI: 200 OK (Primary resource data)
    deactivate Backend
    UI -> UI: Render main page content immediately
    note right of UI: User sees a responsive page quickly.

    UI -> Backend: GET /api/resource/{id}/flexfields?page=1&limit=50
    activate Backend
    note right of UI: Asynchronously requests the first batch of flexfields.

    Backend -> DB: Query for first 50 flexfields (using LIMIT/OFFSET)
    activate DB
    DB --> Backend: Return first batch of flexfields
    deactivate DB

    Backend --> UI: 200 OK (Flexfield Batch 1)
    deactivate Backend

    UI -> UI: Append first batch of flexfields to the page
    UI --> User: Display page with initial set of flexfields
    deactivate UI
end

... User interacts with the page ...

group Lazy Loading Subsequent Flexfields (On-demand)

    activate UI

    activate DB

    deactivate DB

    deactivate Backend
```

```plantuml
    Frontend -> User: Renders and displays the enum list
    deactivate Frontend

    activate Frontend
    Frontend -> User: Displays a form/modal for the new item
    User -> Frontend: Fills form and clicks "Save"
    Frontend -> Backend: POST /api/enums\n{ "name": "NewValue", ... }
    activate Backend
    Backend -> Backend: Validates new item data
    alt Successful Validation
        Backend -> Database: INSERT INTO enums (...) VALUES (...)
        activate Database
        Database --> Backend: Confirms insertion (returns new item ID)
        deactivate Database
        Backend --> Frontend: 201 Created [New Item JSON]
        Frontend -> Frontend: Updates UI to show the new item
        Frontend -> User: Displays success message
    else Validation Fails

    activate Backend

    activate Database
    Database --> Backend: Confirms update
    deactivate Database

    deactivate Backend
    Frontend -> Frontend: Updates the specific item in the UI list
    Frontend -> User: Displays success message
    deactivate Frontend

    activate Backend

    activate Database
    Database --> Backend: Confirms deletion
    deactivate Database
    Backend --> Frontend: 204 No Content
    deactivate Backend
    Frontend -> Frontend: Removes the item from the UI list
    Frontend -> User: Displays success message
    deactivate Frontend
```

```plantuml
    deactivate ui
```

```plantuml
        deactivate db

    deactivate ui
```

```plantuml
@startuml
```
```plantuml
' Titre du diagramme
title Set Game Duration Limit

' Définition des acteurs et des participants
actor "OlderPerson" as User
participant "ALFRED UI" as UI
participant "ALFRED System" as System
participant "Settings Database" as DB
participant "Game Component" as Game

' Séquence pour définir la limite de durée
group Set Duration Limit
    User -> UI: Accesses game settings
    activate UI
    UI -> System: requestGameSettings()
    activate System
    System --> UI: displayCurrentSettings()
    deactivate System
    UI --> User: Shows settings screen

    User -> UI: Sets new game duration limit (e.g., 30 mins)
    UI -> System: setGameDurationLimit(30)
    activate System
    System -> DB: saveSetting("game_duration", 30)
    activate DB
    DB --> System: success
    deactivate DB
    System --> UI: confirmation(success)
    deactivate System
    UI --> User: Displays "Limit updated successfully"
    deactivate UI
end

' Séparateur pour montrer l'utilisation de la limite plus tard
== Gameplay with Duration Limit ==

' Séquence pour démarrer un jeu et appliquer la limite
group Gameplay
    User -> UI: Starts a game
    activate UI
    UI -> System: startGameRequest()
    activate System
    System -> DB: getSetting("game_duration")
    activate DB
    DB --> System: returns limit (30)
    deactivate DB
    System -> Game: launchGameWithTimer(30)
    activate Game
    System --> UI: gameStarted()
    UI --> User: Game screen is displayed
    deactivate UI

    note over Game: Game is being played...

    ... 30 minutes later ...

    Game -> System: notifyTimerExpired()
    System -> Game: endGame()
    deactivate Game
    System -> UI: forceEndGame("Time limit reached")
    activate UI
    UI --> User: Displays "Time's up!" message
    deactivate UI
    deactivate System
end

@enduml
```

```plantuml
autonumber
```

```plantuml
-> IngestionService: Receive new content

activate ValidationService

    activate ContentDB
    ContentDB --> IngestionService: Confirm content saved
    deactivate ContentDB

    IngestionService -> NotificationService: Trigger infringement alert
    activate NotificationService
    NotificationService -> Admin: Notify of potential copyright infringement
    deactivate NotificationService
end
```

```plantuml
@startuml
```
```plantuml
title Automatic Fine Calculation for Delayed Return

actor Member
participant "Library System" as System
participant "Loan Database" as DB
participant "Fine Calculation Service" as FineService
participant "Member Account" as Account

' The process is triggered automatically, for example, by a daily scheduled task
' or when a librarian processes the return. Here, we model the latter.

actor Librarian
Librarian -> System: ProcessReturn(bookId)
activate System

System -> DB: GetLoanDetails(bookId)
activate DB
DB --> System: LoanDetails(memberId, dueDate)
deactivate DB

note over System
  System compares the current date
  with the loan's due date.
end note

alt Return is overdue
    System -> FineService: CalculateFine(dueDate, currentDate)
    activate FineService
    ' The service applies business rules (e.g., fine per day, grace period)
    FineService --> System: FineAmount
    deactivate FineService

    System -> Account: AddFineToAccount(memberId, FineAmount)
    activate Account
    Account --> System: Confirmation
    deactivate Account

    System --> Librarian: Display "Return processed. Fine of [FineAmount] applied to member's account."

    ' The system can also notify the member
    System -> Member: SendFineNotification(FineAmount)

else Return is on time
    System -> DB: UpdateLoanStatus(bookId, "Returned")
    System --> Librarian: Display "Return processed successfully. No fine."
end

deactivate System

@enduml
```

user_story: As a Zooniverse admin, I want to know when I should educate a volunteer.
plantuml:
```plantuml
@startuml
title Volunteer Education Notification Sequence

actor Volunteer
participant "Zooniverse Platform (Panoptes)" as Panoptes
participant "Performance Monitor (Zawesome)" as Zawesome
participant "Notification System" as NotificationSystem
actor "Zooniverse Admin" as Admin

' A volunteer performs work on the platform, creating data to be analyzed.
Volunteer -> Panoptes: Submits classification
Panoptes --> Volunteer: Acknowledges submission

' A separate monitoring process runs periodically to check volunteer performance.
loop Periodically

    Zawesome -> Panoptes: GET /classifications
    activate Zawesome
    activate Panoptes
    Panoptes --> Zawesome: Returns recent classification data
    deactivate Panoptes

    Zawesome -> Zawesome: Analyze volunteer performance against consensus/gold standard
    note right of Zawesome
        This involves checking if a volunteer's
        classifications are consistently incorrect
        or differ significantly from the norm.
    end note

    alt Volunteer performance drops below a defined threshold

        Zawesome -> NotificationSystem: Trigger education_alert(volunteer_id, performance_data)
        activate NotificationSystem
        NotificationSystem -> Admin: Send notification (e.g., via email or Slack)
        note left of Admin
            "Volunteer [ID] may need guidance.
            Accuracy is at [X]% on project [Y]."
        end note
        deactivate NotificationSystem

        Admin -> Admin: Reviews volunteer's work and decides on action

    else else

        Zawesome -> Zawesome: Continue monitoring

    end
    deactivate Zawesome

end
@enduml
```

plantuml:
```plantuml
@startuml
```
```plantuml
title Sequence Diagram: Get Results from Multiple Datasets

actor "API User" as User
participant "API Gateway" as Gateway
participant "Query Service" as QueryService
participant "Dataset Service A" as ServiceA
participant "Dataset Service B" as ServiceB
database "Database A" as DBA
database "Database B" as DBB

User -> Gateway: POST /multi-query\n{ "datasets": ["A", "B"], "filter": "..." }
activate Gateway

Gateway -> QueryService: Forward Query Request
activate QueryService
note right: Authenticates & validates request first

QueryService -> QueryService: Parse request to identify\ntarget datasets and criteria

par Query Dataset A

    activate ServiceA
    ServiceA -> DBA: SELECT * FROM ... WHERE ...
    activate DBA
    DBA --> ServiceA: Return rows for dataset A
    deactivate DBA
    ServiceA --> QueryService: Results for A
    deactivate ServiceA

    activate ServiceB
    ServiceB -> DBB: SELECT * FROM ... WHERE ...
    activate DBB
    DBB --> ServiceB: Return rows for dataset B
    deactivate DBB
    ServiceB --> QueryService: Results for B
    deactivate ServiceB
end

QueryService -> QueryService: Aggregate results from all datasets
note right: Combines data into a single, cohesive response structure

QueryService --> Gateway: Return Aggregated Results
deactivate QueryService

Gateway --> User: 200 OK\n{ "results": { "datasetA": [...], "datasetB": [...] } }
deactivate Gateway

@enduml
```

```plantuml
activate Staff
activate UI

activate Controller
Controller -> Service: getPlanDetails(planId)
activate Service
Service -> Repo: findById(planId)
activate Repo
Repo --> Service: plan
deactivate Repo
Service --> Controller: planDetailsDTO
deactivate Service
Controller --> UI: 200 OK (planDetails)
deactivate Controller

UI --> Staff: Displays plan details
deactivate UI

alt Approve Plan

    Staff -> UI: Enters optional conditions/clearances and clicks "Approve"
    activate UI
    UI -> Controller: POST /api/plans/{planId}/approve\n{ conditions: "..." }
    activate Controller
    Controller -> Service: approvePlan(planId, conditions)
    activate Service
    Service -> Repo: updatePlanStatus(planId, "Approved", conditions)
    activate Repo
    Repo --> Service: updatedPlan
    deactivate Repo
    Service -> Notifier: notifyApplicant(planId, "Approved", conditions)
    activate Notifier
    Notifier -> Applicant: Sends Approval Notification
    deactivate Notifier
    Service --> Controller: success
    deactivate Service
    Controller --> UI: 200 OK (Approval Recorded)
    deactivate Controller
    UI --> Staff: Displays success message
    deactivate UI
    deactivate Staff

    activate UI

    Controller -> Service: failPlan(planId, corrections)
    activate Service
    Service -> Repo: updatePlanStatus(planId, "Failed", corrections)
    activate Repo
    Repo --> Service: updatedPlan
    deactivate Repo
    Service -> Notifier: notifyApplicant(planId, "Failed", corrections)
    activate Notifier
    Notifier -> Applicant: Sends Corrections Notification
    deactivate Notifier
    Service --> Controller: success
    deactivate Service
    Controller --> UI: 200 OK (Failure Recorded)
    deactivate Controller
    UI --> Staff: Displays success message
    deactivate UI
    deactivate Staff

end

@enduml
```

```plantuml
        activate DB

        deactivate DB
```

```plantuml
        FlexService -> Cache: set("flexfields_page_1", data)
        activate Cache
        note right: Store the result in cache for subsequent requests

        deactivate Cache
    else Cache Hit (Data found in cache)

        deactivate Cache
    end
```

```plantuml
deactivate Frontend
note over Archivist, Frontend: UI shows "Import in progress..."

group Asynchronous Background Processing
    Worker -> Queue: Dequeue next import job
    activate Worker
    activate Queue

    deactivate Queue

    Worker -> Storage: Get EAD file using fileReference
    activate Storage
```

```plantuml
' User Story: As an OlderPerson, I want to use ALFRED to control the TV and radio.

    ActorBorderColor #555

    ParticipantBorderColor #007bff
    ParticipantBackgroundColor #eef

title ALFRED: Media Control (TV and Radio)

actor "OlderPerson" as User

participant "ALFRED UI" as UI
participant "ALFRED System" as Alfred
participant "Media Controller" as Controller
participant "TV" as TV
participant "Radio" as Radio

autonumber

User -> UI: Interacts with media control interface
activate UI

opt Control TV
    UI -> Alfred: requestTVControl()
    activate Alfred
    
    alt Turn On TV and Change Channel
        Alfred -> Controller: sendCommand(TV, "POWER_ON")
        activate Controller
        Controller -> TV: powerOn()
        activate TV
        TV --> Controller: status(on)
        deactivate TV
        Controller --> Alfred: commandStatus(TV, "SUCCESS")
        deactivate Controller
        Alfred --> UI: updateStatus("TV is now on")
        
        UI -> Alfred: requestChangeChannel(5)
        Alfred -> Controller: sendCommand(TV, "SET_CHANNEL", 5)
        activate Controller
        Controller -> TV: setChannel(5)
        activate TV
        TV --> Controller: status(channel:5)
        deactivate TV
        Controller --> Alfred: commandStatus(TV, "SUCCESS")
        deactivate Controller
        Alfred --> UI: updateStatus("TV channel set to 5")

    else Adjust TV Volume
        UI -> Alfred: requestAdjustVolume("UP")
        Alfred -> Controller: sendCommand(TV, "VOLUME_UP")
        activate Controller
        Controller -> TV: increaseVolume()
        activate TV
        TV --> Controller: status(volume:15)
        deactivate TV
        Controller --> Alfred: commandStatus(TV, "SUCCESS")
        deactivate Controller
        Alfred --> UI: updateStatus("TV volume increased")
    end
    
    deactivate Alfred
end

opt Control Radio
    UI -> Alfred: requestRadioControl()
    activate Alfred

    alt Turn On Radio
        Alfred -> Controller: sendCommand(Radio, "POWER_ON")
        activate Controller
        Controller -> Radio: powerOn()
        activate Radio
        Radio --> Controller: status(on, station:98.5)
        deactivate Radio
        Controller --> Alfred: commandStatus(Radio, "SUCCESS")
        deactivate Controller
        Alfred --> UI: updateStatus("Radio is now on (98.5 FM)")
    
    else Change Radio Station
        UI -> Alfred: requestChangeStation(101.1)
        Alfred -> Controller: sendCommand(Radio, "SET_STATION", 101.1)
        activate Controller
        Controller -> Radio: setStation(101.1)
        activate Radio
        Radio --> Controller: status(station:101.1)
        deactivate Radio
        Controller --> Alfred: commandStatus(Radio, "SUCCESS")
        deactivate Controller
        Alfred --> UI: updateStatus("Radio station set to 101.1 FM")
    end
    
    deactivate Alfred
end

UI --> User: Displays updated status
deactivate UI

@enduml
```

```plantuml
@startuml
```
```plantuml
title Sequence Diagram: User-Friendly Error Handling

actor "User" as User
participant "Browser" as Browser
participant "WebServer" as WebServer
participant "Application" as App
participant "Database" as DB
participant "LoggingService" as Logger
participant "ErrorController" as ErrorCtrl

User -> Browser: Performs an action (e.g., clicks a link)
Browser -> WebServer: Sends HTTP Request

group Error Scenario
    WebServer -> App: processRequest()
    activate App

    App -> DB: Executes a database operation
    activate DB

    DB -->> App: **X** Fails and throws a DatabaseException
    deactivate DB
    note right of App: An unexpected error occurs, for example,\nthe database is unreachable or a query fails.

    App -> Logger: logError(exceptionDetails, stackTrace)
    note right of App: The system logs the detailed technical error\nfor developers to analyze and fix the issue.
    Logger --> App: return

    App -->> WebServer: **X** Throws ApplicationException
    deactivate App
    note left of WebServer: The application signals a critical failure to the\nweb server's central error handling mechanism.

    WebServer -> ErrorCtrl: handleError(500, exception)
    activate ErrorCtrl

    ErrorCtrl -> ErrorCtrl: Renders a user-friendly error page view
    note right of ErrorCtrl: The controller selects a template that is helpful\nand reassuring to the user, not a technical dump.

    ErrorCtrl -->> WebServer: Returns HTML Response for the error page
    deactivate ErrorCtrl

    WebServer -->> Browser: Sends HTTP 500 Response (with HTML)
    Browser -> User: Displays the "nice" error page
    note left of User: "Oops! Something went wrong.\nOur team has been notified."
end

```

```plantuml
title Plan Review Process

actor "Plan Review Staff" as Staff
participant "Planning System UI" as UI
participant "Application Server" as Server
database "Database" as DB
participant "Notification Service" as Notifier
actor "Applicant"

    ParticipantPadding 20
    BoxPadding 10
    ActorBorderColor black
    ParticipantBorderColor black
}

' Sequence of Interactions

Server -> DB: Query for plans needing review

Staff -> UI: Selects a specific plan to review

Server --> UI: Display plan details and documents

note over Staff: Staff reviews plan documents for compliance

alt Plan is Approved

    Staff -> UI: Clicks "Approve"
    
    opt Add Conditions or Clearances
        Staff -> UI: Enters conditions and/or clearances
    end
    
    UI -> Server: POST /api/plans/{planId}/review (status: "Approved", data: [conditions, clearances])

    Server --> UI: Return success response
    UI --> Staff: Display "Plan status updated to 'Corrections Required'"
```

```plantuml
autonumber
```

```plantuml
Staff -> UI: Searches for an item and views its details
activate UI

activate Service

activate DB
DB --> Service: Item data
deactivate DB

activate DB
DB --> Service: Current collections data
deactivate DB

deactivate Service
UI --> Staff: Displays item details and its assigned collections
deactivate UI

    DB --> Service: Confirmation of insertion

end note

deactivate Service
```

user_story: As an agency user, I want to submit my data elements surrounded by quotation marks, so that Excel won't strip off leading and trailing zeroes.
plantuml:
```plantuml
@startuml
title Data Submission to Preserve Leading/Trailing Zeroes

actor "Agency User" as User

participant "User Interface" as UI
participant "Backend Server" as Backend
database "Database" as DB

skinparam sequenceMessageAlign center

group Data Submission Phase

    User -> UI: 1. Enters data element surrounded by quotes\n(e.g., "00123")
    note right of User: Quotes signal that the value should be treated as text.

    UI -> Backend: 2. Submit data (e.g., POST /api/data)\nPayload contains: {"value": ""00123""}

    Backend -> Backend: 3. Process and sanitize input
    note right of Backend: Backend recognizes the value as a string.\nIt may strip the outer quotes before storage.

    Backend -> DB: 4. Store data in a text-based column\n(e.g., INSERT INTO my_table (value) VALUES ('00123'))
    note right of DB: The column type (e.g., VARCHAR, TEXT)\nensures leading zeroes are preserved.

    DB --> Backend: 5. Confirm successful write
    Backend --> UI: 6. Return success response (e.g., HTTP 201 Created)
    UI --> User: 7. Display "Submission Successful" message

end

group Data Export/Verification Phase (Illustrates the "Why")

    User -> UI: 8. Request data export (e.g., as CSV)
    UI -> Backend: 9. GET /api/data/export.csv

    Backend -> DB: 10. Query for the stored data\n(SELECT value FROM my_table)
    DB --> Backend: 11. Return raw data ('00123')

    Backend -> Backend: 12. Generate CSV content
    note right of Backend: To prevent Excel from stripping zeroes,\nthe backend re-wraps the text value in quotes.\nCSV content becomes: ...,"00123",...

    Backend --> User: 13. Respond with CSV file download

    note over User: The user opens the downloaded CSV file in Excel.\nBecause the value is quoted ("00123"),\nExcel treats it as text and preserves the leading zeroes.

end

@enduml
```

```plantuml
    Admin -> Frontend: 1. Logs in and requests to create a new project
    Frontend -> Backend: 2. Forwards request to create project
    Backend --> Frontend: Returns new project interface

    Admin -> Frontend: 3. Uploads image set & defines features to detect\n(e.g., flooding, damage, shelters)
    Frontend -> Backend: 4. Sends image data and project configuration
    activate Backend

    Backend -> ImageStore: 5. Ingests and stores satellite images
    Backend -> DB: 6. Saves project configuration and workflow rules
    DB --> Backend: Confirms configuration saved
    Backend --> Frontend: 7. Confirms project setup is complete
    deactivate Backend
    Frontend --> Admin: Displays project dashboard

        activate MLService

        deactivate MLService
        Backend -> ClassificationService: 13a. Creates a "verification" task with pre-annotations
    else Manual-Only Workflow
        Backend -> ClassificationService: 11b. Creates a new "annotation" task for an image
    end

    activate ClassificationService
    ClassificationService -> DB: 14. Stores the generated task for volunteers
    DB --> ClassificationService: Confirms task saved
    deactivate ClassificationService

    Backend --> Frontend: 15. Notifies that detection process has started
    deactivate Backend
    Frontend --> Admin: 16. Displays "Detection process is live" message
end
```

plantuml:
```plantuml
@startuml
```
```plantuml
!theme plain
```

```plantuml
title Automatic Copyright Infringement Validation

autonumber

actor Admin
participant "Ingestion Service" as IngestionSvc
participant "Copyright Validation Service" as ValidationSvc
participant "Third-Party Copyright API" as CopyrightAPI
database "Content Repository" as ContentRepo
participant "Notification Service" as NotifierSvc

' The process is triggered automatically upon content ingestion
activate IngestionSvc
IngestionSvc -> ContentRepo: Store content (status: PENDING_VALIDATION)
activate ContentRepo
ContentRepo --> IngestionSvc: Return ContentID
deactivate ContentRepo

IngestionSvc -> ValidationSvc: RequestValidation(ContentID)
deactivate IngestionSvc

activate ValidationSvc
ValidationSvc -> ContentRepo: GetContent(ContentID)
activate ContentRepo
ContentRepo --> ValidationSvc: ContentData
deactivate ContentRepo

ValidationSvc -> CopyrightAPI: CheckCopyright(ContentData)
activate CopyrightAPI
CopyrightAPI --> ValidationSvc: ValidationResult
deactivate CopyrightAPI

alt No Infringement Found
    ValidationSvc -> ContentRepo: UpdateStatus(ContentID, "APPROVED")
    activate ContentRepo
    ContentRepo --> ValidationSvc: OK
    deactivate ContentRepo
else Potential Infringement Found
    ValidationSvc -> ContentRepo: UpdateStatus(ContentID, "FLAGGED_FOR_REVIEW")
    activate ContentRepo
    ContentRepo --> ValidationSvc: OK
    deactivate ContentRepo

    ValidationSvc -> NotifierSvc: SendAlert(ContentID, ValidationResult)
    activate NotifierSvc
```

```plantuml
== 1. Initiate Email Linking ==

User -> FE: Navigates to profile and enters email

activate BE

activate DB

deactivate DB

BE -> BE: Generate unique verification token

activate DB
DB --> BE: Confirm update
deactivate DB

activate EmailSvc

deactivate EmailSvc

BE --> FE: 200 OK: {message: "Verification email sent"}
deactivate BE

FE -> User: Display message:\n"Please check your inbox to complete the process."

... User checks their email ...

activate BE

BE -> DB: Query: Find user by verificationToken
activate DB

deactivate DB

alt Token is valid and not expired

    activate DB
    DB --> BE: Confirm update
    deactivate DB
    BE --> User: HTTP 200: Redirect to "Email Verified" page

    BE --> User: HTTP 400: Display "Invalid or expired link" page
end

deactivate BE
```

```plantuml
participant "Fedora Repository" as Fedora

' Identification of Actors and Components:
' Actor: External System (e.g., an OAI-PMH harvester, another library's catalog, a researcher's script)
' System Component: Discovery Service / API (The public-facing endpoint that "exposes" the data)

note right: Requests the public descriptive record for a specific ETD.

note left: The API translates the public request into a request\n to the internal Fedora repository API.

activate Fedora
Fedora --> Api: Return Metadata Datastream (e.g., RDF, MODS XML)
deactivate Fedora

Api -> Api: Transform Metadata
note right: Transforms the internal Fedora metadata format\n into a standardized, re-usable format\n (e.g., JSON-LD, Dublin Core XML, Schema.org).

Api --> ExternalSystem: 200 OK (Descriptive Record)
deactivate Api
note left: The API returns the transformed, public-friendly\n descriptive record to the external system.
```

```plantuml
deactivate ds1

activate ds2

activate db

deactivate db

deactivate ds2
```

user_story: As an Agency user, I want to be able to include a large number of flexfields without performance impact.
plantuml:
Here's a PlantUML sequence diagram representing the user story about handling a large number of flexfields without performance impact:

```plantuml
@startuml FlexFieldsPerformanceDiagram
left to right direction
title Agency Flexfields Performance Optimization

actor AgencyUser as "Agency User"
participant "Frontend Client" as Frontend
participant "API Gateway" as Gateway
participant "Flexfields Service" as FlexService
participant "Cache Layer" as Cache
participant "Database" as DB
participant "Batch Processor" as BatchProc

note right of AgencyUser: High flexfield count scenario (1000+)
note right: Performance optimization required

AgencyUser -> Frontend: Request with flexfields\n(1000+ fields)
activate Frontend
Frontend -> Gateway: Forward request with pagination\n(100 fields/page)
activate Gateway

note over Frontend,Gateway: Client-side pagination

Gateway -> Cache: Check cached flexfield metadata\n(Last updated: 5min ago)
alt Cached
    Cache --> Gateway: Return cached metadata\n(Response: 200 OK)
    Gateway -> Frontend: Return paginated results\n(Page 1/10)
    deactivate Gateway
    Frontend --> AgencyUser: Render first page\n(With virtual scrolling)
else Not cached
    Gateway -> FlexService: Request flexfield metadata\n(With query hints)
    activate FlexService
    FlexService -> DB: Optimized bulk query\n("WHERE flex_type IN (...)")
    activate DB
    DB --> FlexService: Return result set\n(With row limiting)
    deactivate DB

    note over FlexService: Service-side caching\n(LRU cache with 10k entries)

    FlexService -> Cache: Store metadata\n(TTL: 5 minutes)
    Cache --> FlexService: Confirm
    deactivate FlexService

    FlexService --> Gateway: Return paginated results\n(Page 1/10)
    deactivate FlexService
end

Gateway -> Frontend: Return paginated results\n(Page 1/10)
deactivate Gateway
Frontend --> AgencyUser: Render first page\n(With lazy loading)

loop For remaining pages
    AgencyUser -> Frontend: Scroll to next page
    Frontend -> Gateway: Request next page\n(Page 2/10)
    Gateway -> Cache: Check cache
    alt Cached
        Cache --> Gateway: Return page\n(From cache)
    else Not cached
        Gateway -> FlexService: Request specific page
        FlexService -> DB: Optimized query\n("WHERE id BETWEEN x AND y")
        DB --> FlexService: Return page
        FlexService --> Gateway: Return page
    end
    Gateway --> Frontend: Return page
    Frontend --> AgencyUser: Render next page
end

note right: Total processing time:\n<500ms for initial load\n<200ms for subsequent pages

note over FlexService: Architecture patterns:\n- Virtual pagination\n- Service-side caching\n- Query optimization\n- Asynchronous batch updates

deactivate Frontend
@enduml
```

This diagram illustrates:
1. Client-side pagination to avoid loading all flexfields at once
2. Service-side caching with TTL
3. Optimized database queries with bulk fetching
4. Lazy loading for subsequent pages
5. Asynchronous processing patterns for performance
6. The complete flow from user interaction to data retrieval

The diagram shows how the system handles the performance challenge of many flexfields through multiple optimization layers.

```plantuml
    Processor --> BE: 14. Returns processed metadata + import readiness

    == Import Confirmation ==
    BE --> FE: 15. Displays success with:
       - Processing status
       - Link to imported EAD (if immediate)
       - Option to proceed to import workflow
end

@enduml
```

```plantuml
@startuml CopyrightValidationSequence

autonumber "<b>["

actor Admin as "Admin User"
participant "Ingestion System" as IngestionSys
participant "Content Storage" as ContentStore
participant "Copyright Checker" as CopyrightChecker
participant "Copyright Database" as CopyrightDB
participant "Admin Dashboard" as AdminDashboard

== Automatic Validation Flow ==

Admin -> IngestionSys : Ingest content (video, text, image)\n(Trigger: Upload/Event)
IngestionSys -> ContentStore : Store content\n(metadata + actual content)
ContentStore -> CopyrightChecker : "Check content\nfor infringement\n(contentID: X)"

CopyrightChecker -> CopyrightDB : "Query for matches\n(contentID: X)"
CopyrightDB --> CopyrightChecker : "Return matching records\n(if any)"

alt No infringement found
    CopyrightChecker -> ContentStore : "Mark as validated\n(contentID: X)"
    ContentStore -> IngestionSys : "Content validated\n(contentID: X, status: CLEAN)"
else Infringement detected
    CopyrightChecker -> AdminDashboard : "Raise alert\n(contentID: X, \nreason: INFRINGEMENT)"
    AdminDashboard -> Admin : "Notification: Copyright review\nrequired for content X"
    Admin -> CopyrightChecker : "Manual review action\n(approve/reject)"
    CopyrightChecker -> ContentStore : "Update status\n(contentID: X, \nstatus: REVIEWED)"
end

== Admin Review Flow ==
Admin -> AdminDashboard : Access dashboard\n(filter: pending review)
AdminDashboard -> CopyrightChecker : "Get pending items\n(limit: 10)"
CopyrightChecker --> AdminDashboard : "List items requiring\nreview (contentIDs: [X,Y])"
Admin -> CopyrightChecker : "Admin action\n(contentID: X,\naction: APPROVE/REJECT)"
CopyrightChecker -> ContentStore : "Apply admin decision\n(contentID: X, \nstatus: APPROVED/REJECTED)"
ContentStore -> IngestionSys : "Content status updated"

@enduml
```

2. Automatic copyright validation process
3. Database lookup for matches
4. Branching logic for clean vs infringing content
5. Admin notification and review workflow
6. Final status updates after manual review

- A persistent Copyright Database
- An Admin Dashboard for notifications
- Content Storage that tracks validation status

```plantuml
        deactivate OMS
    end
end
```

```plantuml
alt Plan Incomplete

    notifier --> staff: Alert Notification
    system --> staff: 1.3 Return Error (Missing Data)
else Plan Valid
    system -> engine: 1.4 Run Compliance Checks (Regulations A, B, C)
    engine --> system: 1.4 Compliance Results (Pass/Fail with Notes)

    system -> staff: 1.5 Display Review UI (Plan Data + Compliance Results)

    staff -> system: 2. Submit Decision (Approve/Fail/Deny + Conditions/Clearances)
    system -> repo: 2.1 Update Review Status + Notes
    repo --> system: 2.1 Confirmation

    system -> notifier: 2.2 Send Decision Notification (Applicant + Stakeholders)
    notifier --> applicant: Notification (Decision + Conditions)
```

```plantuml
== Uploading Electronic Publication ==

system -> storage : 9a. Generate access token
```

```plantuml
@startuml Manage Bonds Sequence Diagram

actor StaffMember as "Staff Member"
participant "UI" as StaffUI
participant "BondService" as BondService

participant "NotificationService" as NotificationService
participant "AuditLogger" as AuditLogger

autonumber "<b>Manage Bonds Flow"

StaffMember -> StaffUI: 1. Requests bond management interface\n(Create/Update/Delete/Track bonds)
StaffUI -> BondService: 2. invokes manageBond(operation, bondData)

alt Create New Bond
    BondService -> BondRepository: 3. create(bondData)
    BondRepository --> BondService: 4. Bond created (ID, status)
    BondService -> NotificationService: 5. notifyBondCreated(bondId)
    BondService -> AuditLogger: 6. logAction("CREATE_BOND", bondId)
    BondService --> StaffUI: 7. Confirmation + bond details
else Update Existing Bond
    BondService -> BondRepository: 8. update(bondId, updatedData)
    BondRepository --> BondService: 9. Bond updated (status)
    BondService -> NotificationService: 10. notifyBondUpdated(bondId)
    BondService -> AuditLogger: 11. logAction("UPDATE_BOND", bondId)
    BondService --> StaffUI: 12. Success message
else Delete Bond
    BondService -> BondRepository: 13. delete(bondId)
    BondRepository --> BondService: 14. Bond removed
    BondService -> NotificationService: 15. notifyBondDeleted(bondId)
    BondService -> AuditLogger: 16. logAction("DELETE_BOND", bondId)
    BondService --> StaffUI: 17. Confirmation
else Track Bond Progress
    BondService -> BondRepository: 18. getBond(bondId)
    BondRepository --> BondService: 19. Bond details + lifecycle status
    BondService --> StaffUI: 20. Display bond lifecycle UI
    StaffUI -> BondService: 21. Request lifecycle transition
    BondService -> BondRepository: 22. updateLifecycleStage(bondId, newStage)
    BondRepository --> BondService: 23. Stage updated
    BondService -> AuditLogger: 24. logAction("STAGE_TRANSITION", bondId, newStage)
    BondService --> StaffUI: 25. Updated lifecycle view
end

@enduml
```

plantuml:

```plantuml
participant "User Interface/API Client" as client
participant "API Gateway" as gateway
participant "Request Router" as router
participant "Dataset Service 1" as dataset1
participant "Dataset Service 2" as dataset2
participant "Data Fusion Engine" as fusion
participant "Result Aggregator" as aggregator
participant "Response Formatter" as formatter

user -> client : 1. Sends multi-dataset request\n(IDs: datasetA, datasetB)\nwith query params
client -> gateway : 2. Forwards request to API
gateway -> router : 3. Routes request to Data Fusion

router -> fusion : 4. Initiates cross-dataset query\n"Fetch: datasetA + datasetB"
fusion -> dataset1 : 5. Query datasetA\n"SELECT fields FROM A WHERE conditions"
dataset1 -> fusion : 5. Returns datasetA results\n(structured data)

fusion -> dataset2 : 6. Query datasetB\n"SELECT fields FROM B WHERE conditions"
dataset2 -> fusion : 6. Returns datasetB results\n(structured data)

fusion -> aggregator : 7. Sends merged results\n"Combined: {dataA, dataB}"
aggregator -> aggregator : 8. Processes correlations\nand validates consistency
aggregator -> formatter : 9. Passes processed data\n"Enriched results"

formatter -> aggregator : 10. Formats as requested\n(JSON/CSV/Graph etc.)
aggregator -> router : 11. Returns formatted response
router -> gateway : 12. Returns 200 OK
gateway -> client : 13. Sends response to client
client -> user : 14. Displays/uses multi-dataset results

note right of user
**Error Handling Flows**
- Missing dataset: Returns 404 partial results
- Schema mismatch: Returns 400 with validation errors
- Auth failure: Returns 403
end note

@enduml
```

```plantuml
participant "Response Formatter" as formatter

fusion -> dataset1 : 5. Query datasetA\n"SELECT fields FROM A WHERE conditions"
dataset1 -> fusion : 5. Returns datasetA results\n(structured data)

fusion -> dataset2 : 6. Query datasetB\n"SELECT fields FROM B WHERE conditions"
dataset2 -> fusion : 6. Returns datasetB results\n(structured data)

fusion -> aggregator : 7. Sends merged results\n"Combined: {dataA, dataB}"
aggregator -> aggregator : 8. Processes correlations\nand validates consistency
aggregator -> formatter : 9. Passes processed data\n"Enriched results"

aggregator -> router : 11. Returns formatted response
```

plantuml:
Here’s the PlantUML sequence diagram based on the user story **"As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to locate the ALFRED user"** with the following assumptions for actors and systems:

### **Actors & Systems Identified:**
1. **MedicalCaregiver** (User) – Initiates the request to locate ALFRED.
2. **LocationService** (System) – Handles geolocation or tracking of devices/users.
3. **ALFRED (User/Device)** – The target entity to be located (could be a wearable device, smartphone, or IoT device with location capabilities).
4. **AuthenticationService** (Optional) – Ensures the caregiver has permission to request location data.

---
### **Assumed Sequence of Interactions:**
1. MedicalCaregiver requests ALFRED’s location.
2. AuthenticationService (if present) verifies access.
3. LocationService queries ALFRED’s last known location (e.g., via GPS, Wi-Fi, or Bluetooth).
4. LocationService returns coordinates to the caregiver (or a UI component).

```plantuml
@startuml Locate_ALFRED_Sequence

actor MedicalCaregiver
participant "AuthenticationService" as Auth
participant "LocationService" as LocSvc
participant "ALFRED (User/Device)" as Alfred
participant "UI" as UI

MedicalCaregiver -> UI: Requests "Locate ALFRED"
UI -> Auth: Authenticate (if required)
alt Authenticated
    UI -> LocSvc: Request location data (deviceID = ALFRED)
    LocSvc -> Alfred: Query last known location
    Alfred --> LocSvc: Returns [latitude, longitude, timestamp]
    LocSvc --> UI: Displays location on map
else Unauthorized
    Auth --> UI: "Access Denied"
    UI --> MedicalCaregiver: Show error
end

@enduml
```

---
**Notes:**
- If **ALFRED** is a **wearable device**, `Alfred` might interact with a **DeviceGateway** instead of directly returning coordinates.
- For **real-time tracking**, `LocSvc` could poll `Alfred` periodically or use webhooks.
- Adjust actors/systems based on your actual architecture (e.g., if location is handled by a **Cloud Server** instead of a dedicated `LocationService`).

```plantuml
    service -> cache: 3. Checks cached flexfield definitions\n(if cache miss, proceed)
    cache --> service: 3a. Returns cached definitions (or empty)
    alt Cache miss
        service -> db: 4. Queries DB for flexfield definitions\n(optimized bulk query)
        db --> service: 5. Returns minimal required metadata
        service -> cache: 6. Updates cache with new definitions
    end

    service -> optimizer: 8. Delegates to performance optimizer\n("Optimize flexfield fetch")
    optimizer -> db: 9. Executes optimized query\n("Bulk fetch with pagination/streaming")
    db --> optimizer: 10. Streams/returns batched flexfield data
    optimizer -> service: 11. Processes data (e.g., lazy-loading, compression)

        end

    end
```
