@startuml Library_Bulk_Upload_Sequence_Diagram

actor "Library Staff Member" as staff
rectangle "Library Management System (LMS)" {
    participant "User Interface (UI)" as ui
    participant "Bulk Upload Service" as bulk_service
    participant "Metadata Validator" as validator
    participant "Catalog Database" as catalog_db
    participant "Data Storage Service" as storage_service
    participant "Notification Service" as notifier
}

autonumber "<b>["

staff -> ui: 1. Selects "Bulk Upload" option\n(CSV/Excel/JSON)

        OrderMgmt --> POS : 11a. Notify success\n("Order updated successfully")
    else Table unavailable

    end

@enduml

participant "External Consumer" as Consumer

App -> MetadataService: Validate/update record structure
MetadataService --> App: Confirm updated record
App --> Consumer: Confirm record update

== Error Handling ==
App --> Archivist: Display "Record not found" (if item doesn't exist)
App --> Consumer: Return "404 Not Found" for invalid requests

@enduml
```

actor PlanReviewStaff
actor Applicant

    component PlanRepository
    component ReviewEngine
    component DecisionRecorder
}

PlanReviewStaff -> PlanReviewSystem : Access system
PlanReviewSystem -> PlanRepository : Retrieve plans for review

PlanReviewSystem -> PlanReviewStaff : Display plans for review

loop Review Process
    PlanReviewStaff -> PlanReviewSystem : Select plan to review

    PlanReviewSystem -> PlanReviewStaff : Display compliance results

    end

    PlanReviewSystem -> PlanRepository : Update plan status
    PlanRepository --> PlanReviewSystem : Confirmation
    PlanReviewSystem -> PlanReviewStaff : Notify review completion
end

PlanReviewSystem -> Applicant : Send decision notification
@enduml

participant "Web Server" as Server
participant "Error Handler" as ErrorHandler
participant "Error Page Template" as Template

User -> Browser: Accesses a resource (e.g., /page)

Template --> ErrorHandler: Returns rendered HTML
ErrorHandler --> Server: Returns error response with status code and page
Server --> Browser: Sends HTTP error response with custom error page
Browser --> User: Displays user-friendly error page

note right of User
  User sees a clean, helpful error page
  instead of a technical stack trace
end note

@enduml

        db --> system : Confirmation
        system --> staff : Plan Denied
    end
end

db --> system : Status Updated
system --> staff : Review Completed

end

```

@startuml
title Locate ALFRED User

actor MedicalCaregiver as Caregiver
participant "Caregiver App" as App
participant "ALFRED Cloud" as Cloud
participant "User Device\n(ALFRED Agent)" as Agent
participant "Location Provider\n(GPS/Network)" as Loc
participant "Map Service" as Map

Caregiver -> App: Locate ALFRED user
App -> Cloud: Authenticate caregiver
Cloud --> App: Auth success (token)

App -> Cloud: Request live location (userId)
Cloud -> Agent: Fetch current location

activate Agent
alt Permission granted and device reachable
  Agent -> Loc: Get best available location
  alt GPS fix available
    Loc --> Agent: Coordinates + accuracy + timestamp
  else Network-based fix
    Loc --> Agent: Approx. coordinates + higher uncertainty
  end
  Agent --> Cloud: Location payload
  deactivate Agent

  Cloud --> App: Current location + accuracy
  App -> Map: Render marker(coordinates, accuracy)
  Map --> App: Map tiles + marker
  App --> Caregiver: Display user on map
else Device offline/unreachable
  deactivate Agent
  Cloud --> App: Last known location + staleness
  App --> Caregiver: Show last known location\nwith staleness warning
else Permission denied on device
  Agent --> Cloud: Permission denied
  deactivate Agent
  Cloud --> App: Error: permission denied
  App --> Caregiver: Display error and guidance
end

@enduml

user_story: As a library staff member, I want to be able to assign an item to more than one collection.
plantuml:
@startuml
title Assign item to multiple collections

actor Staff as "Library Staff"
participant UI as "Library System UI"
participant Auth as "Auth Service"
participant ItemSvc as "Item Service"
participant CollSvc as "Collection Service"
database DB as "Library DB"
participant Audit as "Audit Log"

Staff -> UI: Assign item to collections\nitemId, [collectionIds]
UI -> Auth: Verify permission assign_item
alt Not authorized
  Auth --> UI: Denied
  UI --> Staff: Error: Not authorized
else Authorized
  Auth --> UI: OK
  UI -> ItemSvc: Load item(itemId)
  alt Item not found
    ItemSvc --> UI: Not found
    UI --> Staff: Error: Item not found
  else Item found
    ItemSvc --> UI: Item details
    UI -> CollSvc: Load collections([collectionIds])
    alt Some collections missing
      CollSvc --> UI: Missing ids
      UI --> Staff: Error: One or more collections not found
    else All collections found
      CollSvc --> UI: Collections
      UI -> ItemSvc: Assign to collections\nitemId, [collectionIds]
      ItemSvc -> DB: BEGIN TRANSACTION
      loop For each collectionId
        ItemSvc -> CollSvc: addItemToCollection(itemId, collectionId)
        alt Already assigned
          CollSvc --> ItemSvc: No-op
        else Newly assigned
          CollSvc --> ItemSvc: Added
        end
      end
      ItemSvc -> Audit: Record assignment\nstaffId, itemId, [collectionIds]
      ItemSvc -> DB: COMMIT
      alt Commit failed
        DB --> ItemSvc: Error
        ItemSvc -> DB: ROLLBACK
        ItemSvc --> UI: Failure details
        UI --> Staff: Error: Could not save changes
      else Commit succeeded
        DB --> ItemSvc: OK
        ItemSvc --> UI: Assignment result (success)
        UI --> Staff: Success: Item assigned to multiple collections
      end
    end
  end
end

@enduml

user_story: As a DAMS manager, I want to know the agent(s) responsible for carrying out an event.
plantuml:
@startuml
title View responsible agents for an event

actor Manager as "DAMS Manager"
boundary UI as "DAMS UI"
control EventSvc as "Event Service"
control Access as "Access Control"
database EventDB as "Event Repository"
database RelDB as "Event-Agent Relation Repo"
control AgentSvc as "Agent Service"
database AgentDB as "Agent Repository"

Manager -> UI: Select "View responsible agents" for eventId
UI -> EventSvc: getResponsibleAgents(eventId, managerId)

activate EventSvc
EventSvc -> Access: checkPermission(managerId, "VIEW_EVENT_RESPONSIBLE", eventId)
Access --> EventSvc: allowed?
alt Access denied
    EventSvc --> UI: error 403 Forbidden
    deactivate EventSvc
    UI --> Manager: Show "Access denied"
else Access granted
    EventSvc -> EventDB: findEvent(eventId)
    alt Event not found
        EventDB --> EventSvc: null
        EventSvc --> UI: error 404 Event not found
        deactivate EventSvc
        UI --> Manager: Show "Event not found"
    else Event found
        EventDB --> EventSvc: Event
        EventSvc -> RelDB: getAgentIdsByEventAndRole(eventId, "responsible")
        RelDB --> EventSvc: agentIds[]
        alt No agents assigned
            EventSvc --> UI: []
            deactivate EventSvc
            UI --> Manager: Show "No responsible agents assigned"
        else Agents found
            EventSvc -> AgentSvc: getAgents(agentIds[])
            AgentSvc -> AgentDB: findByIds(agentIds[])
            AgentDB --> AgentSvc: agentDetails[]
            AgentSvc --> EventSvc: agentDetails[]
            EventSvc --> UI: agentDetails[]
            deactivate EventSvc
            UI --> Manager: Display agent list
        end
    end
end

@enduml

user_story: As a developer, I want to upgrade to Fedora 4 and migrate our applications and data.
plantuml:
@startuml
title Upgrade to Fedora 4: Applications and Data Migration

actor Developer
participant "CI/CD Pipeline" as CICD
participant "Backup Service" as Backup
participant "Existing Repository\n(Fedora ≤ 3)" as OldRepo
participant "Migration Tool" as Mig
database "Database" as DB
participant "Application Services" as App
participant "Fedora 4 Repository" as F4
participant "QA/Tests" as QA
participant "Monitoring/Logging" as Mon
participant "Load Balancer/DNS" as LB

Developer -> CICD: Initiate upgrade request (target: Fedora 4)
CICD -> Backup: Create full backup (apps + repo + DB)
Backup -> Backup: Verify checksums and integrity
Backup --> CICD: Backup completed

CICD -> App: Enable maintenance mode
CICD -> App: Deploy Fedora 4–compatible application build
CICD -> F4: Provision Fedora 4 environment (infra/config)
CICD -> DB: Apply schema migrations (idempotent)

Developer -> Mig: Define mappings and transformation rules
Mig -> OldRepo: Discover/export objects and metadata

loop Migrate in batches
  Mig -> OldRepo: Export batch (binaries + RDF/metadata)
  Mig -> Mig: Transform/normalize to Fedora 4 model
  Mig -> F4: Ingest batch
  F4 --> Mig: Ingest receipt (OK/Errors)
end

Mig -> App: Update repository endpoint to Fedora 4
CICD -> QA: Run smoke/regression tests
QA --> CICD: Test results

alt All tests pass
  CICD -> LB: Shift traffic to new stack (cutover)
  App -> Mon: Emit health/performance metrics
  Mon --> Developer: Migration healthy
  CICD -> OldRepo: Archive/decommission legacy repo
  CICD -> App: Disable maintenance mode
else Any test fails or health degraded
  CICD -> Backup: Initiate rollback
  Backup -> DB: Restore database
  Backup -> OldRepo: Restore repository data
  Backup -> App: Restore application artifacts/config
  App -> LB: Keep traffic on legacy stack
  CICD -> App: Disable maintenance mode
  Developer -> Mon: Review incident and logs
end

note over Developer, CICD
Goal: Safely upgrade to Fedora 4 and migrate applications and data
Rollback available at every stage after backups complete
end note
@enduml

@startuml
title Delete Book from Library

actor Librarian as L
boundary "Library UI" as UI
control "Library System" as SYS
control "Auth Service" as AUTH
control "Book Service" as BS
control "Loan Service" as LS
control "Audit Service" as AUD
database "Library DB" as DB

L -> UI: Click "Delete" (bookId)
UI -> SYS: requestDelete(bookId, librarianId)

activate SYS
SYS -> AUTH: checkPermission(librarianId, "DELETE_BOOK")
AUTH --> SYS: allowed/denied

alt Access denied
  SYS -> UI: Error "Access denied"
  UI -> L: Show error
else Access granted
  SYS -> BS: getBook(bookId)
  activate BS
  BS -> DB: SELECT book WHERE id=bookId
  DB --> BS: book/null
  deactivate BS

  alt Book not found
    SYS -> UI: Notify "Book not found"
    UI -> L: Show "Book not found"
  else Book exists
    SYS -> LS: hasActiveLoansOrReservations(bookId)
    activate LS
    LS -> DB: SELECT active loans/reservations for bookId
    DB --> LS: count
    deactivate LS

    alt Has active loans/reservations
      SYS -> UI: Cannot delete; explain reason
      UI -> L: Show "Cannot delete: active loans/reservations"
    else No active loans/reservations
      SYS -> UI: Prompt confirmation "Delete book?"
      UI -> L: Ask for confirmation
      L -> UI: Confirm
      UI -> SYS: confirmDelete(bookId)

      SYS -> BS: deleteBook(bookId)
      activate BS
      BS -> DB: UPDATE books SET status='DELETED', deleted_at=NOW() WHERE id=bookId
      DB --> BS: OK
      deactivate BS

      SYS -> AUD: recordDelete(librarianId, bookId)
      AUD -> DB: INSERT audit(event="DELETE_BOOK", actor=librarianId, target=bookId)
      DB --> AUD: OK

      SYS -> UI: Deletion successful
      UI -> L: Show success
    end
  end
end

deactivate SYS

@enduml

database "Cache" as Cache
database "Dataset Service A" as DS_A
database "Dataset Service B" as DS_B
control "Normalizer/Joiner" as Joiner

User -> Gateway: GET /results?datasets=A,B&query=...
activate Gateway
Gateway -> Auth: Validate access token
activate Auth
Auth --> Gateway: Authorized?
deactivate Auth

alt Unauthorized
    Gateway --> User: 401 Unauthorized
    deactivate Gateway
else Authorized
    Gateway -> Agg: Request(datasets=[A,B], query, userCtx)
    activate Agg

    Agg -> Validator: Validate query and datasets
    activate Validator
    Validator --> Agg: Valid?
    deactivate Validator

    alt Invalid
        Agg --> Gateway: 400 Bad Request (invalid query)
        deactivate Agg
        Gateway --> User: 400 Bad Request
        deactivate Gateway
    else Valid
        Agg -> Cache: GET key=hash(query,[A,B])
        activate Cache
        alt Cache Hit
            Cache --> Agg: AggregatedResult
            deactivate Cache
            Agg --> Gateway: 200 AggregatedResult (from cache)
            deactivate Agg
            Gateway --> User: 200 AggregatedResult
            deactivate Gateway
        else Cache Miss
            Cache --> Agg: null
            deactivate Cache

            par Fetch dataset A
                Agg -> DS_A: Fetch(querySubsetA, userCtx)
                activate DS_A
                DS_A --> Agg: PartialResultA
                deactivate DS_A
            and Fetch dataset B
                Agg -> DS_B: Fetch(querySubsetB, userCtx)
                activate DS_B
                DS_B --> Agg: PartialResultB or ErrorB
                deactivate DS_B
            end

            note over Agg

            alt All sources succeeded

                Agg --> Gateway: 200 AggregatedResult
                deactivate Agg
                Gateway --> User: 200 AggregatedResult
                deactivate Gateway
            else Some source failed
                Agg -> Joiner: Merge available results + collect warnings
                activate Joiner
                Joiner --> Agg: PartialAggregatedResult + Warnings
                deactivate Joiner

                Agg --> Gateway: 206 Partial Content (results + warnings)
                deactivate Agg
                Gateway --> User: 206 Partial Content
                deactivate Gateway
            end
        end
    end
end

@enduml

control Gateway as "ALFRED API Gateway"
control Auth as "Auth Service (OAuth2/OIDC)"
control Rate as "Rate Limiter"
control Orchestrator as "ALFRED Orchestrator"
control Engines as "Task Engine(s)"
collections Store as "Knowledge Store"
database DB as "Results DB"
collections Cache as "Cache"
queue Queue as "Job Queue"

note right of Client
  SDK abstracts:
  - Auth/token handling
  - Retries & backoff
  - Serialization/validation
  - Polling for long-running jobs
end note

Dev -> Client: Define goal and call createGoal(goalParams)
Client -> Auth: Request access token (client/app credentials)

alt Valid credentials
  Auth --> Client: Access token
  Client -> Gateway: POST /goals {goalParams} + Bearer token
  Gateway -> Rate: Check quota
  Rate --> Gateway: Allowed
  Gateway -> Orchestrator: startGoal(goalParams, devId)

  Orchestrator -> Cache: Lookup existing result
  alt Result found in cache
    Cache --> Orchestrator: Cached result
    Orchestrator --> Gateway: 200 OK {result}
    Gateway --> Client: 200 OK {result}
    Client --> Dev: Show simplified result
  else Not cached
    alt Small/quick goal
      Orchestrator -> Engines: Plan + execute tasks
      Engines -> Store: Read domain knowledge
      Engines -> DB: Persist final result
      Orchestrator --> Gateway: 200 OK {result}
      Gateway --> Client: 200 OK {result}
      Client --> Dev: Show result
    else Long-running goal
      Orchestrator -> Queue: Enqueue job {jobId}
      Orchestrator --> Gateway: 202 Accepted {jobId}
      Gateway --> Client: 202 Accepted {jobId}

      loop Poll until complete
        Client -> Gateway: GET /goals/{jobId}/status
        Gateway -> Orchestrator: getStatus(jobId)
        Orchestrator -> DB: Fetch status/result
        Orchestrator --> Gateway: status/result
        Gateway --> Client: status/result
      end
      Client --> Dev: Show final result
    end
  end
else Invalid credentials
  Auth --> Client: 401 Unauthorized
  Client --> Dev: Display authentication error
end

@enduml

user_story: As a developer, I want to upgrade to Fedora 4 and migrate our applications and data.
plantuml:
@startuml
title Upgrade to Fedora 4 and Migrate Applications and Data

actor Developer as Dev
participant "Legacy Applications" as LegacyApp
participant "Fedora 3 Repository" as F3
database "Legacy DB" as LegacyDB
participant "Backup Service" as Backup
participant "CI/CD Pipeline" as CICD
participant "Fedora 4 Repository" as F4
database "App DB (New)" as AppDB
boundary "Search Index" as Search
participant "Migration Tool" as Mig
participant "New Applications" as NewApp
control "Load Balancer/DNS" as LB
control "Monitoring" as Mon

autonumber

group Plan and Backups
  Dev -> Backup: Request full backups (F3, LegacyDB)
  Backup -> F3: Create snapshot/backup
  Backup -> LegacyDB: Create snapshot/backup
  Backup --> Dev: Backup reports and artifacts
end

group Provision staging environment (Fedora 4 + apps)
  Dev -> CICD: Run "provision-staging" pipeline
  CICD -> F4: Deploy and configure Fedora 4
  CICD -> AppDB: Provision database schema
  CICD -> Search: Provision index
  CICD -> NewApp: Deploy app version compatible with F4 (staging)
  CICD --> Dev: Deployment status
end

group Configure and run migration (staging)
  Dev -> Mig: Configure mappings, credentials, batch size
  Mig -> F3: Read objects and binaries
  loop For each object
    Mig -> Mig: Transform/Map to Fedora 4 model
    Mig -> F4: Create/Update resource and binaries
    Mig -> Search: Index resource metadata
  end
  Mig --> Dev: Migration summary (successes/errors)
end

group Validate on staging
  Dev -> NewApp: Execute smoke/regression tests
  NewApp -> F4: Read/Write via API
  NewApp -> AppDB: Persist/read app data
  NewApp -> Search: Query index
  NewApp --> Dev: Test results
end

alt Tests passed?
  group Cutover to production
    Dev -> LegacyApp: Set read-only / announce freeze
    Dev -> Mig: Run delta migration (changes since snapshot)
    Mig -> F3: Read changed/new objects
    loop Remaining changes
      Mig -> F4: Apply create/update/delete
      Mig -> Search: Update index
    end
    Dev -> CICD: Promote release to production
    CICD -> NewApp: Deploy production release
    CICD -> F4: Ensure production configuration
    CICD -> AppDB: Run migrations
    Dev -> LB: Switch traffic to new applications
    LB --> Dev: Traffic switched
  end
else Tests failed
  group Rollback
    Dev -> CICD: Roll back staging deployment
    Dev -> F4: Tear down or reset staging environment
    Dev <-- Mig: Keep reports/logs for analysis
  end
end

group Post-cutover monitoring
  Dev -> Mon: Enable/verify dashboards and alerts
  Mon -> NewApp: Collect health/metrics
  Mon -> F4: Collect health/metrics
  Mon --> Dev: Alerts and SLO status
end

@enduml

WebUI -> Audit: Log detection request (params)

user_story: As an Agency user, I want to be able to include a large number of flexfields without performance impact.
plantuml:
@startuml
title Include many flexfields without performance impact

actor "Agency User" as User
boundary UI as "Web App (UI)"
control API as "API Gateway"
control FlexSvc as "Flexfield Service"
control MetaSvc as "Metadata Service"
collections Cache as "Cache"
database DB as "Database"
control Validation as "Validation Service"

autonumber

== Open form with many flexfields ==
User -> UI: Open record/form
UI -> API: GET /flexfields/meta?recordType&recordId

alt Metadata in cache
  API -> Cache: GET flexfield-metadata(key)
  Cache --> API: metadata
else Metadata not in cache
  API -> MetaSvc: GET flexfield metadata(schema/layout)
  MetaSvc -> DB: SELECT schema/layout for recordType
  DB --> MetaSvc: schema/layout
  MetaSvc --> API: metadata
  API -> Cache: PUT flexfield-metadata(key, metadata)
end
API --> UI: metadata summary\n(layout, count, serverPageSize)

note over UI,API
- Request/return only schema and layout summary (no values)
- Enables fast first paint
end note

== Fetch first chunk of values (projection + pagination) ==
UI -> API: GET /flexfields/values?recordId&page=1&size=K&fields=visibleOnly
API -> FlexSvc: Query values(page=1, size=K, projection=visibleOnly)
FlexSvc -> DB: SELECT projected fields\nLIMIT K OFFSET 0
DB --> FlexSvc: values (page 1)
FlexSvc --> API: values (compressed)
API --> UI: values + totalCount

note over API,FlexSvc
Server-side pagination and field projection
reduce payload and query cost
end note

UI -> UI: Render initial chunk lazily

== Lazy load additional pages on demand ==
loop While user scrolls/expands sections
  UI -> API: GET /flexfields/values?page=next&size=K
  API -> FlexSvc: Query values(next page, projection)
  FlexSvc -> DB: SELECT projected fields\nLIMIT K OFFSET next
  DB --> FlexSvc: values (next page)
  FlexSvc --> API: values (compressed)
  API --> UI: values (next page)
end

note over UI
Client-side virtualized rendering
avoids DOM bloat and heavy layouts
end note

== Bulk edit and save without N+1 ==
opt User edits multiple flexfields
  UI -> API: PUT /flexfields/bulk\npayload: changedFields[]
  API -> Validation: Validate rules in bulk
  Validation --> API: Validation OK
  API -> FlexSvc: Persist changes (batch upsert)
  FlexSvc -> DB: UPSERT batch changedFields[]
  DB --> FlexSvc: ack
  FlexSvc --> API: ack
  API --> UI: 200 OK
end

note over API,UI
Batch validation + write avoids per-field round trips
end note
@enduml

user_story: As a researcher, I want to record research publications in the institutional repository or CRIS with DMP records, so that I can generate reports of research output resulting from a project.
plantuml:
@startuml
title Record Publication with DMP and Generate Project Report

autonumber

actor Researcher as R
boundary "Web Portal" as UI
control "SSO / Auth" as Auth
control "Record Manager" as RM
database "Project Registry" as PRJ
database "CRIS" as CRIS
database "Institutional Repository" as IR
collections "DMP Service" as DMP
collections "DOI Registry\n(Crossref/DataCite)" as DOI
control "Reporting Service" as REP

group Authenticate
  R -> UI: Sign in
  UI -> Auth: Authenticate (SSO/OIDC)
  Auth --> UI: Access token / session
  UI --> R: Authenticated
end

group Record a publication
  R -> UI: Start "Record new publication"
  UI -> R: Select target [CRIS|Repository], project, DOI?, DMP?
  R --> UI: Provide selection + metadata

  UI -> RM: CreatePublication(target, projectId, metadata, doi?, dmpRef?)
  RM -> PRJ: Get project(projectId)
  PRJ --> RM: Project details

  alt DOI provided
    RM -> DOI: Lookup(doi)
    DOI --> RM: Publication metadata
    RM -> RM: Pre-fill and deduplicate
  else No DOI
    RM -> UI: Request/validate manual metadata
    UI --> RM: Completed metadata
  end

  RM -> RM: Validate metadata and policies

  alt DMP reference provided
    RM -> DMP: Get DMP(dmpRef)
    DMP --> RM: DMP record
  else No DMP provided
    RM -> DMP: Find DMP by project(projectId)
    DMP --> RM: Matching DMP(s)
  end

  alt Target = CRIS
    RM -> CRIS: Create/Update publication(metadata, projectId, DMP link)
    alt Duplicate found
      CRIS --> RM: Duplicate detected (existingId)
      RM -> UI: Prompt resolve [Update | Link existing | Cancel]
      alt Update or Link
        UI --> RM: Update existing
        RM -> CRIS: Update(existingId, merged data)
        CRIS --> RM: Saved
      else Cancel
        UI --> RM: Cancel operation
        RM --> UI: Aborted
      end
    else Created
      CRIS --> RM: Saved(newId, handle)
    end

    opt No DOI and policy requires PID
      RM -> DOI: Mint DOI(for handle/metadata)
      DOI --> RM: New DOI
      RM -> CRIS: Store DOI with record
    end

  else Target = Repository
    RM -> IR: Deposit item(metadata, files?, projectId, DMP link)
    alt Duplicate found
      IR --> RM: Duplicate detected (existingId)
      RM -> UI: Prompt resolve [Update | Link existing | Cancel]
      alt Update or Link
        UI --> RM: Update existing
        RM -> IR: Update(existingId, merged data)
        IR --> RM: Saved
      else Cancel
        UI --> RM: Cancel operation
        RM --> UI: Aborted
      end
    else Created
      IR --> RM: Saved(newId, handle)
    end

    opt No DOI and policy requires PID
      RM -> DOI: Mint DOI(for handle/metadata)
      DOI --> RM: New DOI
      RM -> IR: Store DOI with record
    end
  end

  RM --> UI: Confirmation (recordId, handle/doi, DMP link)
  UI --> R: Publication recorded
end

group Generate project output report
  R -> UI: Generate report (projectId, filters)
  UI -> REP: BuildReport(projectId, filters)

  par Fetch outputs from CRIS
    REP -> CRIS: Get publications by project(projectId, filters)
    CRIS --> REP: Publication set (with identifiers)
  and Fetch outputs from Repository
    REP -> IR: Get items by project(projectId, filters)
    IR --> REP: Item set (with identifiers)
  end

  REP -> DMP: Resolve DMP linkage for project(projectId)
  DMP --> REP: DMP references

  REP -> REP: Aggregate, deduplicate, summarize
  REP --> UI: Report (summary, list, counts, DMP linkage)
  UI --> R: Report delivered (PDF/CSV)
end
@enduml

title Automatic Copyright Validation on Content Ingest

actor Admin

participant "Ingestion Service" as Ingest
database "Content Repository" as Repo
participant "Validation Orchestrator" as Orchestrator
participant "Fingerprint Service" as FP

participant "External Rights API" as ExtAPI
queue "Notification Service" as Notify
collections "Quarantine Store" as Quarantine
collections "Audit Log" as Audit

== Configure auto-validation (one-time) ==

UI -> Policy: setAutoValidate(true)
Policy --> UI: OK
UI --> Admin: Confirmation

== Automatic validation on ingest ==
Ingest -> Repo: store(newContent, metadata)
Ingest -> Orchestrator: event ContentIngested(contentId)

Orchestrator -> Policy: isAutoValidateEnabled()?
Policy --> Orchestrator: true

Orchestrator -> FP: generateFingerprint(contentId)
FP --> Orchestrator: fingerprint

Orchestrator -> Catalog: findSimilar(fingerprint)
Catalog --> Orchestrator: matches (0..n)

alt Internal match found
  Orchestrator -> Policy: evaluate(matches, metadata)
  Policy --> Orchestrator: decision
  alt decision = "Infringement"
    Orchestrator -> Repo: updateStatus(contentId, "Flagged")
    Orchestrator -> Quarantine: move(contentId)
    Orchestrator -> Notify: notify(Admin, "Infringement detected", reportLink)
  else decision = "NotInfringement"
    Orchestrator -> Repo: updateStatus(contentId, "Cleared")
  end
else No internal match
  Orchestrator -> ExtAPI: checkCopyright(fingerprint, metadata)
  ExtAPI --> Orchestrator: result
  alt result = "Infringement"
    Orchestrator -> Repo: updateStatus(contentId, "Flagged")
    Orchestrator -> Quarantine: move(contentId)
    Orchestrator -> Notify: notify(Admin, "Infringement detected", reportLink)
  else result = "NoIssue"
    Orchestrator -> Repo: updateStatus(contentId, "Cleared")
  else error/timeout
    Orchestrator -> Repo: updateStatus(contentId, "PendingReview")
    Orchestrator -> Notify: alert(Admin, "Validation deferred for contentId")
  end
end

Orchestrator -> Audit: log(contentId, outcome, timestamp)

Notify -> Admin: Alert with validation outcome

@startuml
title Manage Bonds - Sequence Diagram

actor Staff

control WF as "Workflow Engine"
control Notify as "Notification Service"

Staff -> UI: Open "Manage Bonds"
UI -> Auth: authorize(Staff, "MANAGE_BONDS")
alt Authorized
  Auth --> UI: allow

  group Create new bond
    Staff -> UI: Create Bond(details)
    UI -> BondSvc: createBond(details)
    activate BondSvc
    BondSvc -> ProjectSvc: validateProject(details.projectId)
    alt Project valid
      BondSvc -> BondRepo: findByIdentifier(details.identifier)
      alt Duplicate exists
        BondSvc --> UI: error("Bond already exists")
        deactivate BondSvc
      else New
        BondSvc -> WF: start(Bond, initialState=Draft)
        WF --> BondSvc: workflowId, state=Draft
        BondSvc -> BondRepo: save(bond, state=Draft)
        BondSvc -> Notify: notifyStakeholders("BondCreated", bond)
        BondSvc -> Audit: record("BondCreated", bondId)
        BondSvc --> UI: success(bondId)
        deactivate BondSvc
      end
    else Invalid project
      BondSvc --> UI: error("Invalid project")
      deactivate BondSvc
    end
  end

  group Track/Update bond status
    Staff -> UI: Update Status(bondId, nextState)
    UI -> BondSvc: updateStatus(bondId, nextState)
    activate BondSvc
    BondSvc -> WF: transition(bondId, nextState)
    alt Valid transition
      WF --> BondSvc: state=nextState
      BondSvc -> BondRepo: updateState(bondId, nextState)
      BondSvc -> Notify: notifyStakeholders("BondStatusChanged", bondId, nextState)
      BondSvc -> Audit: record("StatusChanged", bondId, nextState)
      BondSvc --> UI: success(nextState)
    else Invalid transition
      WF --> BondSvc: error("Invalid transition")
      BondSvc --> UI: error("Invalid status change")
    end
    deactivate BondSvc
  end

  group Release bond
    Staff -> UI: Release Bond(bondId)
    UI -> BondSvc: releaseBond(bondId)
    activate BondSvc
    BondSvc -> WF: transition(bondId, Released)
    alt Allowed and prerequisites met

      BondSvc -> ProjectSvc: updateBondRelease(bondId)
      BondSvc -> Notify: notifyStakeholders("BondReleased", bondId)
      BondSvc -> Audit: record("BondReleased", bondId)
      BondSvc --> UI: success("Released")
    else Not allowed/prereqs missing
      WF --> BondSvc: error("Prerequisites not met")
      BondSvc --> UI: error("Cannot release bond")
    end
    deactivate BondSvc
  end

  group View bond details and history
    Staff -> UI: View Bond(bondId)
    UI -> BondSvc: getBond(bondId)
    BondSvc -> BondRepo: fetch(bondId)
    BondRepo --> BondSvc: bond
    BondSvc -> Audit: fetchHistory(bondId)
    Audit --> BondSvc: events
    BondSvc --> UI: bond + history
  end

else Unauthorized
  Auth --> UI: deny
  UI --> Staff: Access denied
end

alt Unauthorized
  UI --> E: Show error "Not allowed"
else Authorized
  UI -> TableSvc: Get table(tableNumber)
  TableSvc --> UI: Table info (id, assignedTo, status)

  alt Table not found or not assigned to employee

      UI --> E: Inform no order to change
    else Active order exists

      E -> UI: Edit items (add/remove/change qty)
      loop For each proposed change
        UI -> OrderSvc: Validate change (orderId, delta)
        OrderSvc -> PaySvc: Ensure order is open
        PaySvc --> OrderSvc: OK

        alt Change affects items
          OrderSvc -> InvSvc: Check availability(itemId, qty)
          InvSvc --> OrderSvc: Available/Insufficient
        end

        alt Valid change
          OrderSvc -> PriceSvc: Recalculate totals

        OrderSvc -> OrderRepo: Begin transaction

        else Saved

          OrderSvc -> Audit: Append "Order changed"
          OrderSvc -> OrderRepo: Commit
          OrderSvc --> UI: Success with updated order summary
          UI --> E: Show confirmation
        end
      end

    end
  end

title Specify and validate a data disposal policy

autonumber

' Actors

actor "Compliance Officer" as CO

' System components
boundary "Data Repository UI" as UI
control "Policy Service" as PS
control "Legal/Policy Engine" as LPE

' Phase 1: Initiate policy definition
D -> UI: Open "Set Disposal Policy" for dataset
UI -> D: Display policy form (retention, triggers, disposal method)
D -> UI: Submit proposed disposal policy (policyDraft)

' Phase 2: Validate against rules and agreements
UI -> PS: ProposeDisposalPolicy(datasetId, policyDraft)
PS -> LPE: ValidatePolicy(datasetId, policyDraft)
LPE -> IPR: Fetch applicable regulatory rules
IPR --> LPE: Regulatory rules
LPE -> CAR: Fetch collaboration agreement terms
CAR --> LPE: Agreement terms
LPE --> PS: ValidationResult(status, violations?, recommendations?)
PS -> UI: Present validation result (issues/recommendations)

' Decision paths based on validation
alt Policy compliant
  UI -> D: Show "Compliant" summary and confirmation
  D -> UI: Confirm apply policy
  UI -> PS: ApplyPolicy(datasetId, policyFinal)

  ' Phase 3: Apply and schedule
  PS -> RS: ScheduleDisposal(datasetId, policyFinal)
  RS --> PS: Scheduled(policyId, scheduleId)
  PS -> PStore: SavePolicy(datasetId, policyFinal, scheduleId)
  PStore --> PS: OK

  ' Phase 4: Notify and audit
  PS -> NS: Notify(D, "Disposal policy applied and scheduled")
  PS -> AL: RecordEvent("Policy set", datasetId, policyId, user=D)

else Policy not compliant
  UI -> D: Show violations and options\n- Modify to comply\n- Request exception approval

  alt Depositor modifies to comply
    D -> UI: Update policy per recommendations
    UI -> PS: ResubmitPolicy(datasetId, policyDraft_v2)
    PS -> LPE: ValidatePolicy(datasetId, policyDraft_v2)
    LPE -> IPR: Fetch applicable regulatory rules
    IPR --> LPE: Regulatory rules
    LPE -> CAR: Fetch collaboration agreement terms
    CAR --> LPE: Agreement terms
    LPE --> PS: ValidationResult(status=Compliant, recommendations?)
    PS -> UI: Present compliant result
    UI -> D: Show "Compliant" summary and confirmation
    D -> UI: Confirm apply policy
    UI -> PS: ApplyPolicy(datasetId, policyFinal_v2)

    PS -> RS: ScheduleDisposal(datasetId, policyFinal_v2)
    RS --> PS: Scheduled(policyId, scheduleId)
    PS -> PStore: SavePolicy(datasetId, policyFinal_v2, scheduleId)
    PStore --> PS: OK

    PS -> AL: RecordEvent("Policy set", datasetId, policyId, user=D)

    D -> UI: Request exception (justification)
    UI -> PS: RequestApproval(datasetId, policyDraft, justification)
    PS -> CO: ApprovalRequest(datasetId, deviations, justification)
    CO --> PS: Approve or Deny

    alt Approved

      RS --> PS: Scheduled(policyId, scheduleId)
      PS -> PStore: SavePolicy(datasetId, policyWithException, scheduleId, approvalRef)
      PStore --> PS: OK

      PS -> AL: RecordEvent("Policy set with exception", datasetId, policyId, approver=CO)
    else Denied

      PS -> NS: Notify(D, "Exception request denied")
      PS -> AL: RecordEvent("Approval denied", datasetId, user=D, approver=CO)
    end
  end
end

participant "Auth Service" as Auth

participant "Dataset Service A" as DS_A
participant "Dataset Service B" as DS_B

alt Token invalid
  Auth --> Gateway: 401 Unauthorized
  Gateway --> User: 401 Unauthorized

  Gateway -> Agg: aggregateQuery(query=Q, datasets=[A,B], user=UserId)

    Agg --> Gateway: AggregatedResult
    Gateway --> User: 200 OK\nBody: AggregatedResult
  else One or more sources failed
    Agg -> Agg: Merge available results\nAttach warnings for failed datasets

  end
end
